@if "%DEBUG%" == "" @echo off
@rem ##########################################################################
@rem
@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
@rem
@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS=

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%" == "" set DIRNAME=.
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if "%ERRORLEVEL%" == "0" goto init

echo.
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.
echo.
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
echo location of your Java installation.

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto init

echo.
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME%
echo.
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
echo location of your Java installation.

goto fail

:init
@rem Get command-line arguments, handling Windowz variants

if not "%OS%" == "Windows_NT" goto win9xME_args
if "%@eval[2+2]" == "4" goto 4NT_args

:win9xME_args
@rem Slurp the command line arguments.
set CMD_LINE_ARGS=
set _SKIP=2

:win9xME_args_slurp
if "x%~1" == "x" goto execute

set CMD_LINE_ARGS=%*
goto execute

:4NT_args
@rem Get arguments from the 4NT Shell from JP Software
set CMD_LINE_ARGS=%$

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar

@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %CMD_LINE_ARGS%

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%ERRORLEVEL%"=="0" goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
if  not "" == "%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit 1
exit /b 1

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega

class AuthWrapper extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuthWrapper({super.key});

  @override
  AuthWrapperState createState() => AuthWrapperState();
}

class AuthWrapperState extends State<AuthWrapper> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isAuthenticated = false;
  bool _showLandingPage = false;
  Timer? _sessionRefreshTimer;
  final _sessionService = SessionService();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _sessionService.initialize();
    _checkInitialFlow();
    _setupAuthListener();
    _startSessionRefreshTimer();
    _sessionService.startBackgroundMonitoring();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _sessionRefreshTimer?.cancel();
    _sessionService.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    super.didChangeAppLifecycleState(state);
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed && _isAuthenticated) {
      // App came back from background, refresh session if authenticated
      _refreshSessionIfNeeded();
      _sessionService.recordUserActivity();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshSessionIfNeeded() async {
    try {
      await _sessionService.refreshSessionIfNeeded();
    } catch (e) {
      // Session refresh failed - let auth listener handle it
    }
  }

  void _startSessionRefreshTimer() {
    // Refresh session every 30 minutes
    _sessionRefreshTimer =
        Timer.periodic(const Duration(minutes: 30), (timer) async {
      if (mounted && _isAuthenticated) {
        try {
          await _sessionService.refreshSessionIfNeeded();
          _sessionService.recordUserActivity();
        } catch (e) {
          // Don't force logout on refresh failure, let the auth listener handle it
        }
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _checkInitialFlow() async {
    try {
      // First check if there's an authenticated user
      await _checkAuth();

      // If we get here and user is not authenticated, show landing page
      if (!_isAuthenticated) {
        setState(() {
          _showLandingPage = true;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
        _showLandingPage = true; // Fallback to landing page
      });
    }
  }

  void _setupAuthListener() {
    Supabase.instance.client.auth.onAuthStateChange.listen((data) {
      if (mounted) {
        final isAuthenticated = data.session != null;

        if (data.event == AuthChangeEvent.signedOut) {
          _resetLandingPagePreferenceAndShow();
        } else if (data.event == AuthChangeEvent.tokenRefreshed) {
          setState(() {
            _isAuthenticated = true;
            _isLoading = false;
          });
        } else if (data.event == AuthChangeEvent.signedIn) {
          setState(() {
            _isAuthenticated = true;
            _isLoading = false;
            _showLandingPage = false; // Ensure landing page is hidden
          });
        } else {
          setState(() {
            _isAuthenticated = isAuthenticated;
            _isLoading = false;
            if (isAuthenticated) {
              _showLandingPage = false; // Hide landing page if authenticated
            }
          });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _checkAuth() async {
    try {
      final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;

      if (session == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isAuthenticated = false;
            _isLoading = false;
            // Don't set _showLandingPage here - let _checkInitialFlow handle it
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      // Check if session is expired or will expire soon (within 5 minutes)
      final expiryTime =
          DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(session.expiresAt! * 1000);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final timeUntilExpiry = expiryTime.difference(now);
      final isExpired = timeUntilExpiry.isNegative;
      final willExpireSoon = timeUntilExpiry.inMinutes <= 5;

      if (isExpired || willExpireSoon) {
        try {
          await Supabase.instance.client.auth.refreshSession();
          final newSession = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
          final isValidSession = newSession != null;

          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _isAuthenticated = isValidSession;
              _isLoading = false;
              if (isValidSession) {
                _showLandingPage =
                    false; // Hide landing page if session is valid
              }
            });
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Give the user the benefit of the doubt - might be a temporary network issue
          // Don't immediately log them out unless the session is completely invalid
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _isAuthenticated =
                  !isExpired; // Keep authenticated if not fully expired
              _isLoading = false;
              if (!isExpired) {
                _showLandingPage = false; // Hide landing page if not expired
              }
            });
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isAuthenticated = true;
            _isLoading = false;
            _showLandingPage =
                false; // Ensure landing page is hidden when authenticated
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // On error, try to preserve the session if it exists
      final hasSession = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession != null;
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isAuthenticated =
              hasSession; // Preserve auth state if session exists
          _isLoading = false;
          if (hasSession) {
            _showLandingPage = false; // Hide landing page if session exists
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Reset landing page preference and show landing page (used for sign out)
  Future<void> _resetLandingPagePreferenceAndShow() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove('landing_page_seen');
    await prefs.remove('onboarding_complete');

    setState(() {
      _isAuthenticated = false;
      _isLoading = false;
      _showLandingPage = true; // Show landing page after sign out
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
        body: const Column(
          children: [
            TopProgressBar(
              isVisible: true,
              message: 'Loading ExpTrack...',
            ),
            Expanded(child: SizedBox()),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      body: Navigator(
        key: GlobalKey<NavigatorState>(),
        onGenerateRoute: (settings) {
          if (_showLandingPage) {
            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SimpleLandingPage());
          } else if (_isAuthenticated) {
            return MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => const AuthenticatedWrapper());
          } else {
            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const AuthScreen());
          }
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

// New wrapper to handle onboarding flow for authenticated users
class AuthenticatedWrapper extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuthenticatedWrapper({super.key});

  @override
  State<AuthenticatedWrapper> createState() => AuthenticatedWrapperState();
}

class AuthenticatedWrapperState extends State<AuthenticatedWrapper> {
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _showOnboarding = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _checkOnboardingStatus();
  }

  Future<void> _checkOnboardingStatus() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final hasCompletedOnboarding =
          prefs.getBool('onboarding_complete') ?? false;

      setState(() {
        _showOnboarding = !hasCompletedOnboarding;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _showOnboarding = false; // Default to home screen
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      // Show simple loading screen
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
        body: const Column(
          children: [
            TopProgressBar(
              isVisible: true,
              message: 'Setting up...',
            ),
            Expanded(child: SizedBox()),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (_showOnboarding) {
      // Since onboarding screen doesn't exist, go directly to home screen
      return const HomeScreen();
    }

    return const HomeScreen();
  }
}

class AuthScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String? initialEmail;
  final bool showSignUpFirst;

  const AuthScreen(
      {super.key, this.initialEmail, this.showSignUpFirst = false});

  @override
  AuthScreenState createState() => AuthScreenState();
}

class AuthScreenState extends State<AuthScreen> {
  bool _showSignIn = true;
  String? _emailForSignUp;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Show sign-up first if specified (for new users from landing page)
    _showSignIn = !widget.showSignUpFirst;
  }

  void _toggleForm() {
    setState(() {
      _showSignIn = !_showSignIn;
    });
  }

  void _toggleToSignUpWithEmail(String email) {
    setState(() {
      _showSignIn = false;
      _emailForSignUp = email;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
      body: Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
          child: _showSignIn
              ? SignInForm(
                  toggleForm: _toggleForm,
                  toggleToSignUpWithEmail: _toggleToSignUpWithEmail,
                )
              : SignUpForm(
                  toggleForm: _toggleForm,
                  initialEmail: _emailForSignUp ?? widget.initialEmail,
                ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SignInForm extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback toggleForm;
  final Function(String) toggleToSignUpWithEmail;

  const SignInForm({
    super.key,
    required this.toggleForm,
    required this.toggleToSignUpWithEmail,
  });

  @override
  SignInFormState createState() => SignInFormState();
}

class SignInFormState extends State<SignInForm> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isLoading = false;

  Future<void> _signIn() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    // Check network connectivity first
    final isConnected = await NetworkHelper.isConnected();
    if (!isConnected) {
      if (mounted) {
        NetworkHelper.showNoConnectionMessage(context);
      }
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });

    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text.trim();
    bool userExists = false; // Declare here for use in catch block

    try {
      // Step 1: Check if user exists first
      userExists = await _checkIfUserExists(email);

      // Step 2: Attempt to sign in
      final response = await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signInWithPassword(
        email: email,
        password: password,
      );

      // Additional validation - ensure we have both user and session
      if (response.user == null || response.session == null) {
        throw Exception('Sign-in failed - invalid response from server');
      }

      // Double-check that this is a real authenticated session
      final currentSession = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
      if (currentSession == null ||
          currentSession.user.id != response.user!.id) {
        throw Exception('Authentication validation failed');
      }

      if (mounted) {
        // Clear the form
        _emailController.clear();
        _passwordController.clear();

        // Don't navigate manually - let AuthWrapper handle navigation
        // based on authentication state change

        // Give a small delay to ensure auth state change event propagates
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
      }
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      // Handle email not confirmed error specifically
      if (e.message.contains('Email not confirmed')) {
        if (mounted) {
          _showEmailNotConfirmedDialog(email);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Handle invalid credentials - check if user exists to provide specific error
      if (e.message.contains('Invalid login credentials') ||
          e.message.contains('Invalid email or password') ||
          e.message.contains('Wrong email or password') ||
          e.statusCode == '400') {
        if (userExists) {
          // User exists but password is wrong
          if (mounted) {
            _showWrongPasswordDialog();
          }
        } else {
          // User doesn't exist - redirect to sign-up
          if (mounted) {
            _showInvalidCredentialsDialog(email);
          }
        }
        return;
      }

      // Handle user not found errors (fallback)
      if (e.message.contains('User not found') ||
          e.message.contains('No user found')) {
        if (mounted) {
          _showInvalidCredentialsDialog(email);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Handle other specific errors that might suggest sign-up
      if (e.statusCode == '422' &&
          (e.message.contains('email') || e.message.contains('user'))) {
        if (mounted) {
          _showInvalidCredentialsDialog(email);
        }
        return;
      }

      String userMessage = _getSignInErrorMessage(e);

      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: userMessage,
          type: MessageType.error,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      String userMessage = _getNetworkErrorMessage(e);

      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: userMessage,
          type: MessageType.error,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Check if a user with the given email exists in the database
  Future<bool> _checkIfUserExists(String email) async {
    try {
      // Use Supabase's admin API to check if user exists
      // This is a safer approach than trying to sign in with wrong credentials
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(
        email,
        redirectTo:
            'https://dummy-url-for-check.com', // This won't actually send an email
      );

      // If no exception is thrown, the email exists
      return true;
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      // If the error is about user not found, then user doesn't exist
      if (e.message.contains('User not found') ||
          e.message.contains('No user found') ||
          e.message.contains('Unable to validate email address') ||
          e.statusCode == '422') {
        return false;
      }
      // For other errors, assume user exists (to be safe)
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      // On any other error, assume user exists (to be safe)
      return true;
    }
  }

  String _getSignInErrorMessage(AuthException e) {
    switch (e.statusCode) {
      case '400':
        if (e.message.contains('Invalid login credentials')) {
          return 'Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.';
        }
        if (e.message.contains('Email not confirmed')) {
          return 'Please check your email and click the confirmation link before signing in.';
        }
        return 'Invalid request. Please check your email and password.';
      case '422':
        return 'Invalid email format. Please enter a valid email address.';
      case '429':
        return 'Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.';
      case '500':
        return 'Server error. Please try again in a few moments.';
      default:
        if (e.message.contains('network')) {
          return 'Network error. Please check your internet connection.';
        }
        return e.message.isNotEmpty
            ? e.message
            : 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.';
    }
  }

  // Show dialog when credentials are invalid - suggest sign-up
  void _showInvalidCredentialsDialog(String email) {

              'Welcome to ExpTrack!',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                    color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              'It looks like you might be new to ExpTrack! 🎉',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'Would you like to create an account with:',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),

              decoration: BoxDecoration(

class SignUpForm extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback toggleForm;
  final String? initialEmail;

  const SignUpForm({super.key, required this.toggleForm, this.initialEmail});

  @override
  SignUpFormState createState() => SignUpFormState();
}

class SignUpFormState extends State<SignUpForm> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _firstNameController = TextEditingController();
  final _lastNameController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Pre-fill email if provided
    if (widget.initialEmail != null) {
      _emailController.text = widget.initialEmail!;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _signUp() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    final isConnected = await NetworkHelper.isConnected();
    if (!isConnected) {
      if (mounted) {
        NetworkHelper.showNoConnectionMessage(context);
      }
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });

    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final password = _passwordController.text.trim();
    final firstName = _firstNameController.text.trim();
    final lastName = _lastNameController.text.trim();

    try {
      // Attempt to create the account
      final authResponse = await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signUp(
        email: email,
        password: password,
        data: {
          'first_name': firstName,
          'last_name': lastName,
          'full_name': '$firstName $lastName',
        },
      );

      if (authResponse.user == null) {
        throw Exception(
            'User creation failed - no user returned from Supabase');
      }

      // Check if email confirmation is required
      if (authResponse.session == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          _showSuccessDialog(
            'Account Created!',
            'Please check your email (including spam folder) and click the confirmation link, then sign in.',
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      // If we get here, the user is immediately signed in (email confirmation disabled)
      if (mounted) {
        // Don't navigate manually - let AuthWrapper handle navigation
        // based on authentication state change
      }
    } on AuthException catch (e) {
      String userMessage = _getAuthErrorMessage(e);
      if (mounted) {
        _showErrorDialog('Sign-up Failed', userMessage);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      String userMessage = _getNetworkErrorMessage(e);

      // Check for specific sign-up related errors
      if (e.toString().contains('Database error')) {
        userMessage = 'Unable to save user data. Please try again later.';
      }

      if (mounted) {
        _showErrorDialog('Sign-up Failed', userMessage);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  String _getAuthErrorMessage(AuthException e) {
    switch (e.statusCode) {
      case '422':
        if (e.message.contains('already registered') ||
            e.message.contains('already exists') ||
            e.message.contains('User already registered')) {
          return 'This email is already registered. Please sign in instead.';
        }
        if (e.message.contains('password')) {
          return 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.';
        }
        if (e.message.contains('email')) {
          return 'Please enter a valid email address.';
        }
        return 'Invalid email or password format. Please check your details.';
      case '400':
        if (e.message.contains('password')) {
          return 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.';
        }
        return 'Invalid request. Please check your details.';
      case '429':
        return 'Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.';
      case '500':
        return 'Server error. Please try again in a few moments.';
      default:
        // Handle specific error messages
        if (e.message.contains('already registered') ||
            e.message.contains('already exists')) {
          return 'This email is already registered. Please sign in instead.';
        }
        if (e.message.contains('weak password')) {
          return 'Password is too weak. Please choose a stronger password.';
        }
        if (e.message.contains('invalid email')) {
          return 'Please enter a valid email address.';
        }

        return e.message.isNotEmpty
            ? e.message
            : 'Sign-up failed. Please try again.';
    }
  }

  void _showSuccessDialog(String title, String message) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              Icons.check_circle,
              color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
              size: 28,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                title,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          message,
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
        ),
        actions: [
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
              // If message mentions confirmation, switch to sign-in form
              if (message.contains('confirmation') ||
                  message.contains('sign in')) {
                Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
                  if (mounted) {
                    widget.toggleForm(); // Switch to sign-in form
                  }
                });
              }
            },
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
              foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
            ),
            child: const Text('OK'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showErrorDialog(String title, String message) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              Icons.error_outline,
              color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
              size: 28,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              title,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                    color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          message,
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
        ),
        actions: [
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
              foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
            ),
            child: const Text('OK'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _firstNameController.dispose();
    _lastNameController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        // Don't show progress bar during sign-up - skeleton screen will handle loading
        // TopProgressBar(
        //   isVisible: _isLoading,
        //   message: 'Creating account...',
        // ),
        // Form content
        Form(
          key: _formKey,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Join ExpTrack',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
              TextFormField(
                controller: _emailController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Email',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.email),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                ),
                keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return 'Enter your email';
                  if (!RegExp(r'^[\w-\.]+@([\w-]+\.)+[\w-]{2,4}$')
                      .hasMatch(value)) {
                    return 'Enter a valid email';
                  }
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                controller: _firstNameController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'First Name',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.person),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                ),
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                    return 'Enter your first name';
                  }
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                controller: _lastNameController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Last Name',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.person),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                ),
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                    return 'Enter your last name';
                  }
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                controller: _passwordController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Password',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                ),
                obscureText: true,
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                    return 'Enter your password';
                  }
                  if (value.length < 6) {
                    return 'Password must be at least 6 characters';
                  }
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _signUp,
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                ),
                child: const Text('Sign Up', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: widget.toggleForm,
                child: const Text(
                  'Already have an account? Sign In',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// Network connectivity utility
class NetworkHelper {
  static Future<bool> isConnected() async {
    try {
      final connectivityResult = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      bool hasConnection = connectivityResult.any((result) =>
          result == ConnectivityResult.mobile ||
          result == ConnectivityResult.wifi ||
          result == ConnectivityResult.ethernet);

      if (!hasConnection) {
        return false;
      }

      // Additional check: try to reach a reliable endpoint
      // This helps detect captive portals or limited connectivity
      try {
        // Using a simple HTTP request to check internet access
        final client = HttpClient();
        client.connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 5);
        final request =
            await client.getUrl(Uri.parse('https://www.google.com'));
        final response = await request.close();
        client.close();
        return response.statusCode == 200;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static void showNoConnectionMessage(BuildContext context) {
    TopMessage.show(
      context,
      message:
          'No internet connection. Please check your network and try again.',
      type: MessageType.error,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
    );
  }
}

// Glowing text widget for sign-in button
class _GlowingText extends StatefulWidget {
  final String text;
  final TextStyle? style;

  const _GlowingText({
    required this.text,
    this.style,
  });

  @override
  State<_GlowingText> createState() => _GlowingTextState();
}

class _GlowingTextState extends State<_GlowingText>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _animation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1500),
      vsync: this,
    );
    _animation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0.4,
      end: 1.0,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.easeInOut,
    ));
    _controller.repeat(reverse: true);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _animation,
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Text(
          widget.text,
          style: widget.style?.copyWith(
            color: widget.style?.color?.withValues(alpha: _animation.value),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

// Helper method to get appropriate error message for network-related exceptions
String _getNetworkErrorMessage(dynamic e) {
  // Check for specific network-related exception types
  if (e is SocketException) {
    return 'No internet connection. Please check your network and try again.';
  }
  if (e is TimeoutException) {
    return 'Connection timeout. Please check your internet connection and try again.';
  }
  if (e is HttpException) {
    return 'Network error occurred. Please try again.';
  }

  // Check error message for network-related keywords
  String errorString = e.toString().toLowerCase();
  if (errorString.contains('network') ||
      errorString.contains('connection') ||
      errorString.contains('internet') ||
      errorString.contains('offline') ||
      errorString.contains('timeout') ||
      errorString.contains('unreachable')) {
    return 'Network error. Please check your internet connection and try again.';
  }

  // Default message for other errors
  return 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.';
}

201. lib\models\expense.dart ::
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class Expense {
  final String? id; // Nullable to allow omission during insertion
  final String userId;
  final DateTime expenseDate;
  final String expenseTime;
  final String description;
  final double amount;
  final String method;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final DateTime updatedAt;

  Expense({
    this.id,
    required this.userId,
    required this.expenseDate,
    required this.expenseTime,
    required this.description,
    required this.amount,
    required this.method,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.updatedAt,
  });

  factory Expense.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return Expense(
      id: json['id'] as String?,
      userId: json['user_id'] as String,
      expenseDate: DateTime.parse(json['expense_date'] as String),
      expenseTime: json['expense_time'] as String,
      description: json['description'] as String,
      amount: (json['amount'] as num).toDouble(),
      method: json['method'] as String,
      createdAt: DateTime.parse(json['created_at'] as String),
      updatedAt: DateTime.parse(json['updated_at'] as String),
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    if (id != null) 'id': id,
    'user_id': userId,
    'expense_date': DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(expenseDate),
    'expense_time': expenseTime,
    'description': description,
    'amount': amount,
    'method': method,
    'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    'updated_at': updatedAt.toIso8601String(),
  };
}

202. lib\providers\theme_provider.dart ::
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class ThemeProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  ThemeMode _themeMode = ThemeMode.system;

  ThemeMode get themeMode => _themeMode;

  ThemeProvider() {
    _loadTheme();
  }

  Future<void> _loadTheme() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final savedTheme = prefs.getString('themeMode');
    if (savedTheme != null) {
      _themeMode = ThemeMode.values.firstWhere(
            (mode) => mode.toString() == savedTheme,
        orElse: () => ThemeMode.system,
      );
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> setThemeMode(ThemeMode mode) async {
    _themeMode = mode;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString('themeMode', mode.toString());
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

203. lib\screens\analytics_screen.dart ::
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:fl_chart/fl_chart.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:flutter_spinkit/flutter_spinkit.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import '../services/analytics_service.dart';
import '../services/session_service.dart';
import '../widgets/top_message.dart';
import '../utils/logger.dart';

class AnalyticsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnalyticsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AnalyticsScreen> createState() => _AnalyticsScreenState();
}

class _AnalyticsScreenState extends State<AnalyticsScreen>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  bool _isLoading = true;
  Map<String, dynamic> _analyticsData = {};
  DateTime _selectedMonth = DateTime.now();
  bool _isDayView = false;
  DateTime _selectedDay = DateTime.now();
  final _sessionService = SessionService();

  // Animation controllers for smooth transitions
  late AnimationController _chartAnimationController;
  late AnimationController _viewToggleController;
  late Animation<double> _chartAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _viewToggleAnimation;

  // Cached data for offline access
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _cachedData = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity();

    // Initialize animation controllers
    _chartAnimationController = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
      vsync: this,
    );
    _viewToggleController = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _chartAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _chartAnimationController,
      curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic,
    );
    _viewToggleAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _viewToggleController,
      curve: Curves.easeInOut,
    );

    _loadCachedData();
    _loadAnalyticsData(forceRefresh: true); // Force refresh on initial load
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _chartAnimationController.dispose();
    _viewToggleController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    // Force refresh when returning to this screen (e.g., from expense or balance screens)
    if (mounted && !_isLoading) {
      _loadAnalyticsData(forceRefresh: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadCachedData() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final cachedDataString = prefs.getString('analytics_cache');
      if (cachedDataString != null) {
        _cachedData = Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
          json.decode(cachedDataString).map(
                (key, value) => MapEntry(key, Map<String, dynamic>.from(value)),
              ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Failed to load cached data - will use fresh data instead
      Logger.debug('Failed to load cached analytics data: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveCachedData() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString('analytics_cache', json.encode(_cachedData));
    } catch (e) {
      // Failed to save cached data - not critical, continue without caching
      Logger.debug('Failed to save analytics cache: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadAnalyticsData({bool forceRefresh = false}) async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity();

    try {
      final userId = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
      if (userId == null) throw Exception('User not authenticated');

      final cacheKey =
          '${userId}_${_selectedMonth.year}_${_selectedMonth.month}';

      // Try to use cached data first for faster loading (unless force refresh)
      if (!forceRefresh && _cachedData.containsKey(cacheKey)) {
        setState(() {
          _analyticsData = _cachedData[cacheKey]!;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
        _chartAnimationController.forward();
      }

      // Fetch fresh data in background (or force fetch if requested)
      final data = forceRefresh
          ? await AnalyticsService.forceRefreshAnalyticsData(
              userId,
              _selectedMonth.year,
              _selectedMonth.month,
            )
          : await AnalyticsService.getAnalyticsData(
              userId,
              _selectedMonth.year,
              _selectedMonth.month,
            );

      // Log analytics data fetch for debugging
      Logger.debug(
          'Analytics data fetched successfully for ${_selectedMonth.year}-${_selectedMonth.month}');

      // Cache the fresh data
      _cachedData[cacheKey] = data;
      await _saveCachedData();

      // Check if this is the first day of transactions (smart default to day view)
      final dailyExpenses =
          data['daily_expenses'] as Map<String, double>? ?? {};
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final todayKey = now.toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
      final isCurrentMonth =
          _selectedMonth.year == now.year && _selectedMonth.month == now.month;

      // Count days with transactions this month
      int daysWithTransactions =
          dailyExpenses.values.where((amount) => amount > 0).length;

      // If it's current month and only today has transactions, default to day view
      if (isCurrentMonth &&
          daysWithTransactions <= 1 &&
          dailyExpenses[todayKey] != null &&
          dailyExpenses[todayKey]! > 0) {
        _isDayView = true;
        _selectedDay = now;
      }

      setState(() {
        _analyticsData = data;
        _isLoading = false;
      });

      _chartAnimationController.forward();
    } catch (e) {
      // Try to use cached data as fallback
      final userId = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
      if (userId != null) {
        final cacheKey =
            '${userId}_${_selectedMonth.year}_${_selectedMonth.month}';
        if (_cachedData.containsKey(cacheKey)) {
          setState(() {
            _analyticsData = _cachedData[cacheKey]!;
            _isLoading = false;
          });
          _chartAnimationController.forward();

          if (mounted) {
            TopMessage.show(
              context,
              message: 'Using offline data - check your connection',
              type: MessageType.info,
            );
          }
          return;
        }
      }

      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Failed to load analytics data',
          type: MessageType.error,
        );
      }
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _changeMonth(int delta) {
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity();
    _chartAnimationController.reset();
    setState(() {
      _selectedMonth =
          DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month + delta);
    });
    _loadAnalyticsData();
  }

  void _changeDay(int delta) {
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity();
    _chartAnimationController.reset();
    setState(() {
      _selectedDay = DateTime(
          _selectedDay.year, _selectedDay.month, _selectedDay.day + delta);
      // Update selected month to match the day
      _selectedMonth = DateTime(_selectedDay.year, _selectedDay.month);
    });
    _loadAnalyticsData();
  }

  void _showDatePicker() async {
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity();

    if (_isDayView) {
      final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
        context: context,
        initialDate: _selectedDay,
        firstDate: DateTime(2020),
        lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365)),
        helpText: 'Select Date',
      );
      if (picked != null && picked != _selectedDay) {
        _chartAnimationController.reset();
        setState(() {
          _selectedDay = picked;
          _selectedMonth = DateTime(picked.year, picked.month);
        });
        _loadAnalyticsData();
      }
    } else {
      final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
        context: context,
        initialDate: _selectedMonth,
        firstDate: DateTime(2020),
        lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365)),
        helpText: 'Select Month',
        initialDatePickerMode: DatePickerMode.year,
      );
      if (picked != null) {
        _chartAnimationController.reset();
        setState(() {
          _selectedMonth = DateTime(picked.year, picked.month);
        });
        _loadAnalyticsData();
      }
    }
  }

  String _getMonthName(int month) {
    const months = [
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December'
    ];
    return months[month - 1];
  }

  Widget _buildViewToggle(String label, bool isDayToggle) {
    final isActive = _isDayView == isDayToggle;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _viewToggleAnimation,
      builder: (context, child) {
        return GestureDetector(
          onTap: () {
            _sessionService.recordUserActivity();
            _viewToggleController.forward().then((_) {
              _viewToggleController.reverse();
            });
            _chartAnimationController.reset();
            setState(() {
              _isDayView = isDayToggle;
              if (isDayToggle && _selectedDay.month != _selectedMonth.month) {
                _selectedDay =
                    DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month, 1);
              }
            });
            _loadAnalyticsData();
          },
          child: AnimatedContainer(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isActive
                  ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor
                  : Colors.transparent,
              border: Border.all(
                color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                width: 2,
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25),
              boxShadow: isActive
                  ? [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Theme.of(context)
                            .primaryColor
                            .withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                        blurRadius: 8,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                      ),
                    ]
                  : null,
            ),
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: isActive
                        ? Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor
                        : Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 14,
                  ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSummaryCards() {
    final totalExpense = _analyticsData['total_expense'] ?? 0.0;
    final totalIncome = _analyticsData['total_income'] ?? 0.0;
    final netAmount = totalIncome - totalExpense;
    final totalBalance = (_analyticsData['cash_balance'] ?? 0.0) +
        (_analyticsData['online_balance'] ?? 0.0);

    Logger.debug(
        'Summary cards - Total expense: $totalExpense, Total income: $totalIncome');

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          'Financial Summary',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
              ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: _buildSummaryCard(
                'Total Income',
                totalIncome,
                Icons.trending_up,
                const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: _buildSummaryCard(
                'Total Expenses',
                totalExpense,
                Icons.trending_down,
                const Color(0xFFF44336),
              ),
            ),
          ],

        Row(

                'Net Savings',
                netAmount,
                netAmount >= 0 ? Icons.savings : Icons.warning,

  }

  String _formatAmount(double amount) {
    // Use whole numbers or floating numbers (no K/L abbreviations)
    if (amount == amount.toInt()) {
      return amount.toInt().toString();
    } else {
      return amount.toStringAsFixed(2);
    }
  }

    );
  }

  // Day view chart methods

    if (spots.isEmpty) {

    final maxY = spots.map((s) => s.y).reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);

        titlesData: _buildDayTitlesData(maxY + padding, 'Expenses'),

        maxY: maxY + padding,
        lineBarsData: [
          LineChartBarData(

            color: const Color(0xFFF44336),
            barWidth: 3,
            isStrokeCapRound: true,
            dotData: FlDotData(
              show: true,
              getDotPainter: (spot, percent, barData, index) {
                return FlDotCirclePainter(
                  radius: 4,
                  color: const Color(0xFFF44336),
                  strokeWidth: 2,
                  strokeColor: Colors.white,
                );
              },
            ),
            belowBarData: BarAreaData(
              show: true,

            ),

        lineTouchData: _buildLineTouchData('Expense'),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDayBalanceChart() {
    final balanceSpots = _generateHourlyBalanceSpots();
    final incomeSpots = _generateHourlyIncomeSpots();

    if (balanceSpots.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(
        child: Text('No balance data available for this day'),
      );
    }

    final allSpots = [...balanceSpots, ...incomeSpots];
    final maxY = allSpots.isNotEmpty
        ? allSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b)
        : balanceSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
    final minY = allSpots.isNotEmpty
        ? allSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b)
        : balanceSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b);
    final range = maxY - minY;
    final padding = range > 0 ? range * 0.1 : maxY * 0.1;

    Logger.debug(
        'Balance chart - Balance spots: ${balanceSpots.length}, Income spots: ${incomeSpots.length}');

    return LineChart(
      LineChartData(
        gridData: _buildGridData(),
        titlesData: FlTitlesData(
          show: true,
          rightTitles:
              const AxisTitles(sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
          topTitles:
              const AxisTitles(sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
          bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              reservedSize: 40, // Increased to accommodate time labels
              getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
                // Find the closest transaction time
                if (balanceSpots.isNotEmpty) {
                  final closestTime = balanceSpots.map((spot) => spot.x).reduce(
                      (a, b) => (value - a).abs() < (value - b).abs() ? a : b);
                  if ((value - closestTime).abs() < 0.01) {
                    // Small threshold for floating-point comparison
                    final timeString = _decimalHourToTimeString(closestTime);
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                      child: Text(
                        timeString,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                              fontSize: 10,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                }
                return const SizedBox.shrink();
              },
            ),
          ),
          leftTitles: AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              reservedSize: 60,
              interval: _calculateOptimalYInterval(maxY),
              getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
                return Text(
                  _formatCurrency(value),
                  style: Theme.of(context)
                      .textTheme
                      .bodySmall
                      ?.copyWith(fontSize: 10),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
        borderData: _buildBorderData(),
        minX: balanceSpots.isNotEmpty ? balanceSpots.first.x : 0,
        maxX: balanceSpots.isNotEmpty ? balanceSpots.last.x : 23,
        minY: (minY - padding).clamp(0, double.infinity),
        maxY: maxY + padding,
        lineBarsData: [
          // Balance line
          LineChartBarData(
            spots: balanceSpots,
            isCurved: true,
            color: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
            barWidth: 3,
            isStrokeCapRound: true,
            dotData: FlDotData(
              show: true,
              getDotPainter: (spot, percent, barData, index) =>
                  FlDotCirclePainter(
                radius: 4,
                color: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
                strokeWidth: 2,
                strokeColor: Colors.white,
              ),
            ),
            belowBarData: BarAreaData(
              show: true,
              color: const Color(0xFF2196F3).withValues(alpha: 0.1),
            ),
          ),
          // Income points
          if (incomeSpots.isNotEmpty)
            LineChartBarData(
              spots: incomeSpots,
              isCurved: false,
              color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
              barWidth: 2,
              isStrokeCapRound: true,
              dotData: FlDotData(
                show: true,
                getDotPainter: (spot, percent, barData, index) =>
                    FlDotCirclePainter(
                  radius: 6,
                  color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                  strokeColor: Colors.white,
                  strokeWidth: 2,
                ),
              ),
              belowBarData: BarAreaData(show: false),
            ),
        ],
        lineTouchData: LineTouchData(
          enabled: true,
          touchSpotThreshold: 15,
          touchTooltipData: LineTouchTooltipData(
            getTooltipColor: (touchedSpot) => Theme.of(context).cardColor,
            tooltipBorder: BorderSide(
              color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
              width: 1,
            ),
            tooltipRoundedRadius: 8,
            tooltipPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            getTooltipItems: (touchedSpots) {
              return touchedSpots.map((spot) {
                final timeLabel = _decimalHourToTimeString(spot.x);
                return LineTooltipItem(
                  '$timeLabel\nBalance: ${_formatCurrency(spot.y)}',
                  TextStyle(
                    color: spot.bar.color,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 11,
                  ),
                );
              }).toList();
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Month view chart methods
  Widget _buildMonthExpenseChart() {
    final spots = _generateDailyExpenseSpots();
    if (spots.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(

      );
    }

    final maxY = spots.map((s) => s.y).reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
    final minX = spots.map((s) => s.x).reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b);
    final maxX = spots.map((s) => s.x).reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);
    final padding = maxY * 0.1;

    return LineChart(
      LineChartData(
        gridData: _buildGridData(),
        titlesData: _buildMonthTitlesData(maxY + padding, 0.0),
        borderData: _buildBorderData(),
