        maxX: maxX,
        minY: 0,
        maxY: maxY + padding,
        lineBarsData: [
          LineChartBarData(
            spots: spots,
            isCurved: true,
            color: const Color(0xFFF44336),
            barWidth: 3,
            isStrokeCapRound: true,
            dotData: FlDotData(
              show: true,
              getDotPainter: (spot, percent, barData, index) {
                return FlDotCirclePainter(
                  radius: 4,
                  color: const Color(0xFFF44336),
                  strokeWidth: 2,
                  strokeColor: Colors.white,
                );
              },
            ),
            belowBarData: BarAreaData(
              show: true,
              color: const Color(0xFFF44336).withValues(alpha: 0.1),
            ),
          ),
        ],
        lineTouchData: _buildLineTouchData('Expense'),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMonthBalanceChart() {
    final balanceSpots = _generateDailyBalanceSpots();
    final incomeSpots = _generateDailyIncomeSpots();

    // Log the number of spots for debugging

    // Handle empty data case
    if (balanceSpots.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(
        child: Text('No balance data available for this month'),
      );
    }

    // Calculate min/max values safely
    final allSpots = [...balanceSpots, ...incomeSpots];
    double maxY, minY;
    if (allSpots.isNotEmpty) {
      maxY = allSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce(math.max);
      minY = allSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce(math.min);
    } else {
      // Fallback for when only balanceSpots has data
      maxY = balanceSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce(math.max);
      minY = balanceSpots.map((s) => s.y).reduce(math.min);
    }

    // Ensure minY and maxY are valid (not NaN or infinite)
    if (maxY.isNaN || maxY.isInfinite) maxY = 100.0;
    if (minY.isNaN || minY.isInfinite) minY = 0.0;

    // Adjust range if minY equals maxY to prevent chart rendering issues
    if (minY == maxY) {
      if (minY > 0) {
        minY = 0; // Positive balance, start y-axis at 0
      } else if (minY < 0) {
        maxY = 0; // Negative balance, extend to 0
      } else {
        minY = -1; // Zero balance, create a small range
        maxY = 1;
      }
    }

    // Calculate x-axis bounds, adjusting for single point
    final minX = balanceSpots.length > 1
        ? balanceSpots.map((s) => s.x).reduce(math.min)
        : balanceSpots.first.x - 0.5; // Small offset for single point
    final maxX = balanceSpots.length > 1
        ? balanceSpots.map((s) => s.x).reduce(math.max)
        : balanceSpots.first.x + 0.5; // Small offset for single point

    // Calculate padding based on range
    final range = maxY - minY;
    final padding =
        range > 0 ? range * 0.1 : 1.0; // Minimum padding if range is 0

    Logger.debug(
        'Month balance chart - Balance spots: ${balanceSpots.length}, Income spots: ${incomeSpots.length}');

    return LineChart(
      LineChartData(
        gridData: _buildGridData(),
        titlesData:
            _buildMonthTitlesData(maxY, minY), // Pass minY for better interval
        borderData: _buildBorderData(),
        minX: minX,
        maxX: maxX,
        minY: minY - padding,
        maxY: maxY + padding,
        lineBarsData: [
          // Balance line (cumulative)
          LineChartBarData(
            spots: balanceSpots,
            isCurved: true,
            color: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
            barWidth: 3,
            isStrokeCapRound: true,
            dotData: FlDotData(
              show: true,
              getDotPainter: (spot, percent, barData, index) =>
                  FlDotCirclePainter(
                radius: 4,
                color: const Color(0xFF2196F3),
                strokeWidth: 2,
                strokeColor: Colors.white,
              ),
            ),
            belowBarData: BarAreaData(
              show: balanceSpots.length > 1, // Disable for single point
              color: const Color(0xFF2196F3).withValues(alpha: 0.1),
            ),
          ),
          // Income points
          if (incomeSpots.isNotEmpty)
            LineChartBarData(
              spots: incomeSpots,
              isCurved: false,
              color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
              barWidth: 2,
              isStrokeCapRound: true,
              dotData: FlDotData(
                show: true,
                getDotPainter: (spot, percent, barData, index) =>
                    FlDotCirclePainter(
                  radius: 6,
                  color: const Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                  strokeColor: Colors.white,
                  strokeWidth: 2,
                ),
              ),
              belowBarData: BarAreaData(show: false),
            ),
        ],
        lineTouchData: _buildLineTouchData('Balance'),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Chart building helper methods
  FlGridData _buildGridData() {
    return FlGridData(
      show: true,
      drawVerticalLine: true,
      drawHorizontalLine: true,
      getDrawingVerticalLine: (value) {
        return FlLine(
          color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
          strokeWidth: 0.8,
        );
      },
      getDrawingHorizontalLine: (value) {
        return FlLine(
          color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
          strokeWidth: 0.8,
        );
      },
    );
  }

  FlTitlesData _buildDayTitlesData(double maxY, String chartType) {
    return FlTitlesData(
      show: true,
      rightTitles: const AxisTitles(sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
      topTitles: const AxisTitles(sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
      bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
        sideTitles: SideTitles(
          showTitles: true,
          reservedSize: 30,
          getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
            final hour = value.toInt();

            // For expense chart, only show labels at peak and trough points
            if (chartType == 'Expenses') {
              final peakTroughHours = _getPeakTroughHours();
              if (peakTroughHours.contains(hour)) {
                return Text(
                  '$hour:00',
                  style: Theme.of(context)
                      .textTheme
                      .bodySmall
                      ?.copyWith(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                );
              }
              return const SizedBox.shrink();
            } else {
              // For balance chart, show regular interval labels
              if (hour % 4 == 0 && hour >= 0 && hour <= 23) {
                return Text(
                  '$hour:00',
                  style: Theme.of(context)
                      .textTheme
                      .bodySmall
                      ?.copyWith(fontSize: 10),
                );
              }
              return const SizedBox.shrink();
            }
          },
        ),
      ),
      leftTitles: AxisTitles(
        sideTitles: SideTitles(
          showTitles: true,
          reservedSize: 60,
          interval: _calculateOptimalYInterval(maxY),
          getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
            return Text(
              _formatCurrency(value),
              style:
                  Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 10),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  FlTitlesData _buildMonthTitlesData(double maxY, double minY) {
    final daysInMonth =
        DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month + 1, 0).day;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final isCurrentMonth =
        _selectedMonth.year == now.year && _selectedMonth.month == now.month;
    final maxDayToShow = isCurrentMonth ? now.day : daysInMonth;
    final xInterval = maxDayToShow > 20 ? 5.0 : (maxDayToShow > 10 ? 2.0 : 1.0);

    // Calculate y-axis interval based on range
    final range = maxY - minY;
    final baseInterval = range > 0 ? range / 5 : 1.0; // Aim for ~5 labels
    final adjustedYInterval = baseInterval.clamp(1.0, range / 2).ceilToDouble();

    Logger.debug(
        'Month titles - Y-axis range: $minY to $maxY, interval: $adjustedYInterval');

    return FlTitlesData(
      show: true,
      rightTitles: const AxisTitles(sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
      topTitles: const AxisTitles(sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false)),
      bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
        sideTitles: SideTitles(
          showTitles: true,
          reservedSize: 30,
          interval: xInterval,
          getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
            final day = value.toInt();
            if (day >= 1 &&
                day <= maxDayToShow &&
                (day % xInterval).toInt() == 0) {
              return Text(
                day.toString(),
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
              );
            }
            return const SizedBox.shrink();
          },
        ),
      ),
      leftTitles: AxisTitles(
        sideTitles: SideTitles(
          showTitles: true,
          reservedSize: 60,
          interval: adjustedYInterval,
          getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
            // Ensure value is within range to avoid invalid titles
            if (value >= minY && value <= maxY) {
              final formattedValue = _formatCurrency(value);

              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                child: Text(
                  formattedValue,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                ),
              );
            }
            return const SizedBox.shrink();
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  FlBorderData _buildBorderData() {
    return FlBorderData(
      show: true,
      border: Border(
        bottom: BorderSide(
          color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          width: 1,
        ),
        left: BorderSide(
          color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          width: 1,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  LineTouchData _buildLineTouchData(String dataType) {
    return LineTouchData(
      enabled: true,
      touchSpotThreshold: 15,
      touchTooltipData: LineTouchTooltipData(
        getTooltipColor: (touchedSpot) => Theme.of(context).cardColor,
        tooltipBorder: BorderSide(
          color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
          width: 1,
        ),
        tooltipRoundedRadius: 8,
        tooltipPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
        getTooltipItems: (touchedSpots) {
          return touchedSpots.map((spot) {
            final timeLabel =
                _isDayView ? '${spot.x.toInt()}:00' : 'Day ${spot.x.toInt()}';
            return LineTooltipItem(
              '$timeLabel\n$dataType: ${_formatCurrency(spot.y)}',
              TextStyle(
                color: spot.bar.color,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 11,
              ),
            );
          }).toList();
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // Data generation methods
  List<FlSpot> _generateHourlyExpenseSpots() {
    final dateKey = _selectedDay.toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
    final dailyExpenses =
        _analyticsData['daily_expenses'] as Map<String, double>? ?? {};
    final todayExpense = dailyExpenses[dateKey] ?? 0.0;

    // DEBUG: Print analytics data structure

    if (todayExpense == 0) {
      return [];
    }

    // Get actual transaction data for this day
    return _fetchRealTransactionSpots(dateKey);
  }

  List<FlSpot> _fetchRealTransactionSpots(String dateKey) {
    final List<FlSpot> spots = [];

    // Get the timeline data that was fetched earlier
    final timelineData =
        _analyticsData['timeline_data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];

    // Filter transactions for the selected day and expenses only
    final dayTransactions = timelineData.where((transaction) {
      final entryDate = transaction['entry_date'] as String?;
      final transactionType = transaction['transaction_type'] as String?;
      return entryDate == dateKey && transactionType == '-';
    }).toList();

    if (dayTransactions.isEmpty) {
      return [];
    }

    // Group transactions by hour and sum amounts
    final Map<int, double> hourlyExpenses = {};

    for (final transaction in dayTransactions) {
      try {
        final entryTime = transaction['entry_time'] as String? ?? '12:00:00';
        final amount = (transaction['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;

        // Parse hour from entry_time (format: HH:MM:SS)
        final timeParts = entryTime.split(':');
        final hour = int.parse(timeParts[0]);

        // Sum amounts for the same hour
        hourlyExpenses[hour] = (hourlyExpenses[hour] ?? 0.0) + amount;

        Logger.debug(
            'Transaction: ${transaction['description']} at $entryTime (Hour $hour): ₹$amount');
      } catch (e) {
        // Failed to parse transaction data - skip this transaction
        Logger.debug('Failed to parse transaction: $e');
      }
    }

    // Convert to FlSpot and sort by hour
    hourlyExpenses.forEach((hour, totalAmount) {
      spots.add(FlSpot(hour.toDouble(), totalAmount));
    });

    spots.sort((a, b) => a.x.compareTo(b.x));

    Logger.debug(
        'Generated ${spots.length} hourly expense spots for transaction analysis');

    return spots;
  }

  // Helper method to find peak and trough hours for Day View expense chart
  Set<int> _getPeakTroughHours() {
    final spots = _generateHourlyExpenseSpots();
    final Set<int> peakTroughHours = {};

    Logger.debug(
        'Analyzing peak/trough hours for ${spots.length} expense spots');

    if (spots.isEmpty) {
      return peakTroughHours;
    }

    // Find the highest expense point (peak)
    double maxExpense = 0;
    int peakHour = 0;

    // Find the lowest expense point (trough)
    double minExpense = double.infinity;
    int troughHour = 0;

    for (FlSpot spot in spots) {
      final hour = spot.x.toInt();
      final expense = spot.y;

      // Track highest expense
      if (expense > maxExpense) {
        maxExpense = expense;
        peakHour = hour;
      }

      // Track lowest expense
      if (expense < minExpense) {
        minExpense = expense;
        troughHour = hour;
      }
    }

    // Add peak and trough hours
    if (maxExpense > 0) {
      peakTroughHours.add(peakHour);
    }

    if (minExpense != double.infinity && minExpense != maxExpense) {
      peakTroughHours.add(troughHour);
    }

    // Always include first and last hours if they have data
    if (spots.isNotEmpty) {
      final firstHour = spots.first.x.toInt();
      final lastHour = spots.last.x.toInt();
      peakTroughHours.add(firstHour);
      peakTroughHours.add(lastHour);
    }

    return peakTroughHours;
  }

  List<FlSpot> _generateHourlyBalanceSpots() {
    final dateKey = _selectedDay.toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
    final timelineData =
        _analyticsData['timeline_data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];

    // Filter transactions for the selected day
    final dayTransactions =
        timelineData.where((t) => t['entry_date'] == dateKey).toList();

    if (dayTransactions.isEmpty) {
      return [];
    }

    // Sort transactions by time
    dayTransactions.sort((a, b) {
      final timeA =
          _timeStringToDecimalHour(a['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00');
      final timeB =
          _timeStringToDecimalHour(b['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00');
      return timeA.compareTo(timeB);
    });

    final List<FlSpot> spots = [];
    double runningBalance = 0.0;

    // Add starting point at 00:00:00
    spots.add(FlSpot(0.0, runningBalance));

    for (final transaction in dayTransactions) {
      try {
        final amount = (transaction['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
        final transactionType =
            transaction['transaction_type'] as String? ?? '-';
        final entryTime = transaction['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00';
        final decimalHour = _timeStringToDecimalHour(entryTime);

        // Update balance based on transaction type
        if (transactionType == '+') {
          runningBalance += amount;
        } else if (transactionType == '-') {
          runningBalance -= amount;
        }

        spots
            .add(FlSpot(decimalHour, runningBalance.clamp(0, double.infinity)));
        Logger.debug(
            'Balance update - Time: $entryTime, Type: $transactionType, Amount: ₹$amount, Balance: ₹$runningBalance');
      } catch (e) {
        // Failed to parse balance transaction - skip this transaction
        Logger.debug('Failed to parse balance transaction: $e');
      }
    }

    // Add endpoint at 23:59:59 if no transaction at that time
    if (spots.last.x < 23.999) {
      spots.add(FlSpot(23.999, runningBalance.clamp(0, double.infinity)));
    }

    return spots;
  }

  List<FlSpot> _generateHourlyIncomeSpots() {
    final dateKey = _selectedDay.toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
    final timelineData =
        _analyticsData['timeline_data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];

    // Filter income transactions for the selected day
    final incomeTransactions = timelineData
        .where(
            (t) => t['entry_date'] == dateKey && t['transaction_type'] == '+')
        .toList();

    if (incomeTransactions.isEmpty) {
      return [];
    }

    final List<FlSpot> spots = [];
    Logger.debug(
        'Processing ${incomeTransactions.length} income transactions for $dateKey');
    for (final transaction in incomeTransactions) {
      try {
        final amount = (transaction['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
        final entryTime = transaction['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00';
        final decimalHour = _timeStringToDecimalHour(entryTime);

        spots.add(FlSpot(decimalHour, amount));
      } catch (e) {
        // Failed to parse income transaction - skip this transaction
        Logger.debug('Failed to parse income transaction: $e');
      }
    }

    spots.sort((a, b) => a.x.compareTo(b.x));

    return spots;
  }

  List<FlSpot> _generateDailyExpenseSpots() {
    final dailyExpenses =
        _analyticsData['daily_expenses'] as Map<String, double>? ?? {};
    final List<FlSpot> spots = [];

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final isCurrentMonth =
        _selectedMonth.year == now.year && _selectedMonth.month == now.month;
    final daysInMonth =
        DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month + 1, 0).day;
    final maxDayToShow = isCurrentMonth ? now.day : daysInMonth;

    for (int day = 1; day <= maxDayToShow; day++) {
      final dateKey = DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month, day)
          .toIso8601String()
          .split('T')[0];
      final expenseValue = dailyExpenses[dateKey] ?? 0.0;

      if (expenseValue > 0) {
        spots.add(FlSpot(day.toDouble(), expenseValue));
      }
    }

    return spots;
  }

  List<FlSpot> _generateDailyBalanceSpots() {
    final timelineData =
        _analyticsData['timeline_data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
    final List<FlSpot> spots = [];

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final isCurrentMonth =
        _selectedMonth.year == now.year && _selectedMonth.month == now.month;
    final daysInMonth =
        DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month + 1, 0).day;
    final maxDayToShow = isCurrentMonth ? now.day : daysInMonth;

    // Filter transactions for the selected month
    final monthTransactions = timelineData.where((transaction) {
      final entryDate = transaction['entry_date'] as String?;
      if (entryDate == null) return false;

      final transactionDate = DateTime.parse(entryDate);
      return transactionDate.year == _selectedMonth.year &&
          transactionDate.month == _selectedMonth.month &&
          transactionDate.day <= maxDayToShow;
    }).toList();

    if (monthTransactions.isEmpty) {
      // Add a single spot to prevent empty chart
      spots.add(const FlSpot(1.0, 0.0));

      return spots;
    }

    // Sort transactions by date and time
    monthTransactions.sort((a, b) {
      final dateA = DateTime.parse(a['entry_date'] as String);
      final dateB = DateTime.parse(b['entry_date'] as String);
      final dateComparison = dateA.compareTo(dateB);
      if (dateComparison != 0) return dateComparison;

      // If same date, sort by time
      final timeA = a['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00';
      final timeB = b['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00';
      return timeA.compareTo(timeB);
    });

    double runningBalance = 0.0;
    int lastDay = 0;

    // Add starting point
    final firstTransactionDate =
        DateTime.parse(monthTransactions.first['entry_date'] as String);
    if (firstTransactionDate.day > 1) {
      // Add point at day 1 if first transaction is not on day 1
      spots.add(const FlSpot(1.0, 0.0));
      lastDay = 1;
    }

    Logger.debug(
        'Processing ${monthTransactions.length} transactions for ${_getMonthName(_selectedMonth.month)} ${_selectedMonth.year}');

    for (final transaction in monthTransactions) {
      try {
        final amount = (transaction['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
        final transactionType =
            transaction['transaction_type'] as String? ?? '-';
        final entryDate = transaction['entry_date'] as String;
        final transactionDate = DateTime.parse(entryDate);
        final day = transactionDate.day;

        // Update balance based on transaction type
        if (transactionType == '+') {
          runningBalance += amount;
        } else if (transactionType == '-') {
          runningBalance -= amount;
        }

        // Ensure balance doesn't go negative (clamp to 0)
        final balance = runningBalance < 0 ? 0.0 : runningBalance;

        // If this is a new day and we haven't added a point for the previous day, add one
        if (day > lastDay + 1) {
          // Fill gap days with the same balance
          for (int fillDay = lastDay + 1; fillDay < day; fillDay++) {
            spots.add(FlSpot(fillDay.toDouble(), spots.last.y));
          }
        }

        spots.add(FlSpot(day.toDouble(), balance));
        lastDay = day;

        Logger.debug(
            'Day $day ($entryDate): Type: $transactionType, Amount: ₹$amount, Balance: ₹$balance');
      } catch (e) {
        // Failed to parse daily balance transaction - skip this transaction
        Logger.debug('Failed to parse daily balance transaction: $e');
      }
    }

    // Fill remaining days with the final balance
    if (lastDay < maxDayToShow) {
      for (int fillDay = lastDay + 1; fillDay <= maxDayToShow; fillDay++) {
        spots.add(FlSpot(fillDay.toDouble(), spots.last.y));
      }
    }

    Logger.debug(
        'Generated ${spots.length} daily balance spots for month progression');

    return spots;
  }

  List<FlSpot> _generateDailyIncomeSpots() {
    final timelineData =
        _analyticsData['timeline_data'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
    final List<FlSpot> spots = [];

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final isCurrentMonth =
        _selectedMonth.year == now.year && _selectedMonth.month == now.month;
    final maxDayToShow = isCurrentMonth ? now.day : 31;

    // Filter income transactions for the selected month
    final incomeTransactions = timelineData.where((transaction) {
      final entryDate = transaction['entry_date'] as String?;
      final transactionType = transaction['transaction_type'] as String?;
      if (entryDate == null || transactionType != '+') return false;

      final transactionDate = DateTime.parse(entryDate);
      return transactionDate.year == _selectedMonth.year &&
          transactionDate.month == _selectedMonth.month &&
          transactionDate.day <= maxDayToShow;
    }).toList();

    if (incomeTransactions.isEmpty) {
      return spots;
    }

    // Group income transactions by day and sum amounts
    final Map<int, double> dailyIncomeMap = {};

    for (final transaction in incomeTransactions) {
      try {
        final amount = (transaction['amount'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
        final entryDate = transaction['entry_date'] as String;
        final transactionDate = DateTime.parse(entryDate);
        final day = transactionDate.day;

        dailyIncomeMap[day] = (dailyIncomeMap[day] ?? 0.0) + amount;
        Logger.debug(
            'Day $day: Added income ₹$amount, Total: ₹${dailyIncomeMap[day]}');
      } catch (e) {
        // Failed to parse daily income transaction - skip this transaction
        Logger.debug('Failed to parse daily income transaction: $e');
      }
    }

    // Convert to FlSpot list
    dailyIncomeMap.forEach((day, totalIncome) {
      spots.add(FlSpot(day.toDouble(), totalIncome));
    });

    spots.sort((a, b) => a.x.compareTo(b.x));

    return spots;
  }

  // Helper methods
  double _calculateOptimalYInterval(double maxY) {
    if (maxY <= 0) return 1; // Prevent zero/negative intervals
    if (maxY <= 100) return 20;
    if (maxY <= 500) return 100;
    if (maxY <= 1000) return 200;
    if (maxY <= 5000) return 500;
    if (maxY <= 10000) return 1000;
    if (maxY <= 50000) return 5000;
    return 10000;
  }

  String _formatCurrency(double value) {
    if (value == 0) return '₹0';
    if (value < 1000) {
      return '₹${value.toInt()}';
    } else if (value < 100000) {
      return '₹${(value / 1000).toStringAsFixed(1)}K';
    } else {
      return '₹${(value / 100000).toStringAsFixed(1)}L';
    }
  }

  // Helper method to convert decimal hour to time string (HH:MM:SS)
  String _decimalHourToTimeString(double decimalHour) {
    final hours = decimalHour.floor();
    final minutes = ((decimalHour - hours) * 60).floor();
    final seconds = (((decimalHour - hours) * 60 - minutes) * 60).round();
    return '${hours.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${minutes.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  // Helper method to convert time string (HH:MM:SS) to decimal hours
  double _timeStringToDecimalHour(String timeString) {
    final parts = timeString.split(':');
    final hours = int.parse(parts[0]);
    final minutes = int.parse(parts[1]);
    final seconds = int.parse(parts[2]);
    return hours + (minutes / 60.0) + (seconds / 3600.0);
  }

  // Helper method to get transaction times for the selected day
}

  final String value;
  final Color? color;

  LegendItem(this.label, this.value, [this.color]);

class BalanceScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BalanceScreen({super.key});

  @override
  BalanceScreenState createState() => BalanceScreenState();
}

class BalanceScreenState extends State<BalanceScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  final _sessionService = SessionService();
  double _cashBalance = 0.0;
  double _onlineBalance = 0.0;
  double _totalBalance = 0.0;
  double _incrementalTotal = 0.0;
  double _decrementalTotal = 0.0;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  int _selectedMonth = DateTime.now().month;
  final int _selectedYear = DateTime.now().year;
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _bounceAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity(); // Record activity on screen load
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      vsync: this,
    );
    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 1.0, end: 1.07).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );
    _bounceAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: -2.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.bounceOut),
    );
    _fetchData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _fetchData() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    _sessionService.recordUserActivity(); // Record activity on data fetch
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
      if (currentUser == null) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error: User not authenticated',
          type: MessageType.error,
        );
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/auth');
        return;
      }
      final userId = currentUser.id;

      final balances = await _supabaseService.getBalancesByMonth(
          userId, _selectedYear, _selectedMonth);
      final transactionTotals = await _supabaseService
          .getTransactionTotalsByMonth(userId, _selectedYear, _selectedMonth);

      setState(() {
        _cashBalance = balances['cash'] ?? 0.0;
        _onlineBalance = balances['online'] ?? 0.0;
        _totalBalance = balances['total'] ?? 0.0;
        _incrementalTotal = transactionTotals['incremental'] ?? 0.0;
        _decrementalTotal = transactionTotals['decremental'] ?? 0.0;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error fetching data: $e',
          type: MessageType.error,
        );
      }
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _cashBalance = 0.0;
          _onlineBalance = 0.0;
          _totalBalance = 0.0;
          _incrementalTotal = 0.0;
          _decrementalTotal = 0.0;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _onTapDown(TapDownDetails details) {
    _controller.forward();
  }

  void _onTapUp(TapUpDetails details) {
    _controller.reverse().then((_) {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => TimelineScreen(
            year: _selectedYear,
            month: _selectedMonth,
          ),
        ),
      ).then((_) => _fetchData());
    });
  }

  void _onTapCancel() {
    _controller.reverse();
  }

    super.initState();
    _fetchExpenses();

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;

      if (currentUser == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Error: User not authenticated')),
          );
          Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
            context,
            MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
            (route) => false,
          );
        }
        return;
      }
      final userId = currentUser.id;
      _expenses = await _supabaseService.getExpensesByDate(userId, widget.date);
      // Expenses fetched successfully
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Error fetching expenses: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {

    );

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ExpenseScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ExpenseScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ExpenseScreenState createState() => ExpenseScreenState();
}

class ExpenseScreenState extends State<ExpenseScreen> {
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  List<Expense> _expenses = [];
  int _selectedMonth = DateTime.now().month;
  final int _selectedYear = DateTime.now().year;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetchExpenses();
  }

  Future<void> _fetchExpenses() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;

      if (currentUser == null) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Error: User not authenticated')),
        );
        Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
          (route) => false,
        );
        return;
      }
      final userId = currentUser.id;
      _expenses = await _supabaseService.getExpensesByMonth(
          userId, _selectedYear, _selectedMonth);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Error fetching expenses: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Map<int, Map<String, double>> _aggregateExpensesByDay() {
    final Map<int, Map<String, double>> dailyTotals = {};

    for (var expense in _expenses) {
      final day = expense.expenseDate.day;
      dailyTotals[day] ??= {'cash': 0.0, 'online': 0.0, 'total': 0.0};
      if (expense.method == 'cash') {
        dailyTotals[day]!['cash'] = dailyTotals[day]!['cash']! + expense.amount;
      } else if (expense.method == 'online') {
        dailyTotals[day]!['online'] =
            dailyTotals[day]!['online']! + expense.amount;
      }
      dailyTotals[day]!['total'] = dailyTotals[day]!['total']! + expense.amount;
    }

    dailyTotals.removeWhere((day, totals) => totals['total'] == 0.0);

    return dailyTotals;
  }

  void _addExpense() {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (context) => Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
          bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom,
        ),
        child: AddExpenseForm(
          onExpenseAdded: () {
            _fetchExpenses();
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

            Expanded(

                    )
                  : dailyTotals.isEmpty
                      ? const Center(child: Text('No expenses for this month'))
                      : Padding(

class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  HomeScreenState createState() => HomeScreenState();
}

class HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen> {
  bool _isSigningOut = false; // Track sign-out state
  final _sessionService = SessionService();

  // Simple and efficient logout method
  Future<void> _simpleSignOut() async {
    if (_isSigningOut) return; // Prevent multiple calls

    setState(() {
      _isSigningOut = true;
    });

    try {
      // Stop session monitoring to prevent conflicts during logout
      _sessionService.stopBackgroundMonitoring();

      // Perform sign out
      await Supabase.instance.client.auth.signOut();

      // Reset the signing out state
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isSigningOut = false;
        });
      }

      // No manual navigation or dialogs - AuthWrapper will handle navigation
      // to SimpleLandingPage based on auth state change
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        top_msg.TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error signing out. Please try again.',
          type: top_msg.MessageType.error,
        );
        setState(() {
          _isSigningOut = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _showSettingsMenu(BuildContext context) {
    final themeProvider = Provider.of<ThemeProvider>(context, listen: false);
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
          backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
          title: Text(
            'Settings',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                ),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          content: StatefulBuilder(
            builder: (context, setDialogState) {
              return Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Theme',
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                        ),
                  ),
                  RadioListTile<ThemeMode>(
                    title: const Text('Light'),
                    value: ThemeMode.light,
                    groupValue: themeProvider.themeMode,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        themeProvider.setThemeMode(value!);
                      });
                    },
                    activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                  ),
                  RadioListTile<ThemeMode>(
                    title: const Text('Dark'),
                    value: ThemeMode.dark,
                    groupValue: themeProvider.themeMode,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        themeProvider.setThemeMode(value!);
                      });
                    },
                    activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                  ),
                  const Divider(),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: _isSigningOut
                        ? SizedBox(

209. lib\screens\timeline_screen.dart ::
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../services/supabase_service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_spinkit/flutter_spinkit.dart';
import '../widgets/edit_balance_form.dart';

class TimelineScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final int year;
  final int month;

  const TimelineScreen({super.key, required this.year, required this.month});

  @override
  TimelineScreenState createState() => TimelineScreenState();
}

class TimelineScreenState extends State<TimelineScreen> {
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _transactions = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetchTransactions();
  }

  Future<void> _fetchTransactions() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
      if (currentUser == null) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Error: User not authenticated')),
        );
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/auth');
        return;
      }
      final userId = currentUser.id;
      _transactions = await _supabaseService.getTransactionTimeline(
          userId, widget.year, widget.month);

      // Sort transactions by date and time in descending order (newest first)
      _transactions.sort((a, b) {
        // final aDate = DateTime.parse(a['entry_date']);
        // final bDate = DateTime.parse(b['entry_date']);
        final aTimeString = a['transaction_type'] == '+'
            ? (a['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00')
            : (a['expense_time'] as String? ??
                a['entry_time'] as String? ??
                '00:00:00');
        final bTimeString = b['transaction_type'] == '+'
            ? (b['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00')
            : (b['expense_time'] as String? ??
                b['entry_time'] as String? ??
                '00:00:00');
        final aDateTime = DateTime.parse('${a['entry_date']} $aTimeString');
        final bDateTime = DateTime.parse('${b['entry_date']} $bTimeString');

        return bDateTime.compareTo(aDateTime); // Descending order
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('Error fetching transactions: $e')),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _showEditForm(Map<String, dynamic> transaction) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => EditBalanceForm(
        transaction: transaction,
        onBalanceUpdated: _fetchTransactions,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          'Transaction Timeline - ${DateFormat.MMMM().format(DateTime(widget.year, widget.month))}',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                fontSize: 24,
              ),
        ),
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? Center(
              child: SpinKitSquareCircle(
                color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                size: 50.0,
              ),
            )
          : _transactions.isEmpty
              ? const Center(child: Text('No transactions for this month'))
              : ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16.0),
                  itemCount: _transactions.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final transaction = _transactions[index];
                    final isAdd = transaction['transaction_type'] == '+';
                    final amount = transaction['amount'] as double;
                    final method = transaction['method'] as String;
                    final description = transaction['description'] as String? ??
                        'No description';
                    final entryDate = transaction['entry_date'] as String;
                    // Use entry_time for increments, expense_time for decrements
                    final timeString = isAdd
                        ? (transaction['entry_time'] as String? ?? '00:00:00')
                        : (transaction['expense_time'] as String? ??
                            transaction['entry_time'] as String? ??
                            '00:00:00');
                    // Combine date and time
                    final dateTime = DateTime.parse('$entryDate $timeString');
                    final isFirstOfDate = index == 0 ||
                        DateFormat.yMd().format(DateTime.parse(
                                _transactions[index]['entry_date'])) !=
                            DateFormat.yMd().format(DateTime.parse(
                                _transactions[index - 1]['entry_date']));

                    return Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        if (isFirstOfDate)
                          Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 16.0, vertical: 8.0),
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 12.0, vertical: 6.0),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: Theme.of(context)
                                    .primaryColor
                                    .withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                DateFormat.yMMMMd()
                                    .format(DateTime.parse(entryDate)),
                                style: Theme.of(context)
                                    .textTheme
                                    .bodyMedium
                                    ?.copyWith(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                    ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16.0),
                          child: Row(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Column(
                                children: [
                                  Container(
                                    width: 16,
                                    height: 16,
                                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12.0),
                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      color: isAdd ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  if (index < _transactions.length - 1)
                                    Container(
                                      width: 2,
                                      height: 80,
                                      color: Theme.of(context)
                                          .primaryColor
                                          .withValues(alpha: .3),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 16.0),
                              Expanded(
                                child: GestureDetector(
                                  onTap: () => _showEditForm(transaction),
                                  child: Card(
                                    elevation: 4,
                                    color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
                                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                    ),
                                    child: Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12.0),
                                      child: Row(
                                        children: [
                                          Icon(
                                            method == 'cash'
                                                ? Icons.money
                                                : Icons.payment,
                                            color: isAdd
                                                ? Colors.green
                                                : Colors.red,
                                            size: 30,
                                          ),
                                          const SizedBox(width: 12.0),
                                          Expanded(
                                            child: Column(
                                              crossAxisAlignment:
                                                  CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                              children: [
                                                Text(
                                                  isAdd
                                                      ? 'Credited ₹${amount.toStringAsFixed(1)} to ${method.capitalize()} from $description'
                                                      : 'Debited ₹${amount.toStringAsFixed(1)} from ${method.capitalize()} for $description',
                                                  style: Theme.of(context)
                                                      .textTheme
                                                      .bodyLarge
                                                      ?.copyWith(
                                                        fontWeight:
                                                            FontWeight.bold,
                                                        color: isAdd
                                                            ? Colors.green
                                                            : Colors.red,
                                                      ),
                                                ),
                                                const SizedBox(height: 4.0),
                                                Text(
                                                  DateFormat.jm()
                                                      .format(dateTime),
                                                  style: Theme.of(context)
                                                      .textTheme
                                                      .bodyMedium
                                                      ?.copyWith(
                                                        color: Colors.grey[600],
                                                      ),
                                                ),
                                              ],
                                            ),
                                          ),

                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    );
                  },
                ),
    );
  }

extension StringExtension on String {
  String capitalize() {
    return "${this[0].toUpperCase()}${substring(1)}";
  }

210. lib\services\analytics_service.dart ::
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import '../services/supabase_service.dart';
import '../utils/logger.dart';

class AnalyticsService {
  static Database? _database;
  static const String _analyticsTable = 'analytics_cache';

  static Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDatabase();
    return _database!;
  }

  static Future<Database> _initDatabase() async {
    String path = join(await getDatabasesPath(), 'exptrack_analytics.db');

    return await openDatabase(
      path,
      version: 2, // Incremented version for schema change
      onCreate: (Database db, int version) async {
        // Create analytics cache table
        await db.execute('''
          CREATE TABLE $_analyticsTable (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            month_year TEXT NOT NULL,
            daily_expenses TEXT NOT NULL,
            daily_balances TEXT NOT NULL,
            total_expense REAL NOT NULL,
            total_income REAL NOT NULL,
            cash_balance REAL NOT NULL,
            online_balance REAL NOT NULL,
            timeline_data TEXT NOT NULL,
            cached_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(user_id, month_year)
          )
        ''');
      },
      onUpgrade: (Database db, int oldVersion, int newVersion) async {
        if (oldVersion < 2) {
          // Add timeline_data column for existing databases
          await db.execute(
              'ALTER TABLE $_analyticsTable ADD COLUMN timeline_data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ""');
        }
      },
    );
  }

  // Cache analytics data for a specific month
  static Future<void> cacheAnalyticsData(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    final db = await database;
    final supabaseService = SupabaseService();

    try {
      // Get expenses for the month
      final expenses =
          await supabaseService.getExpensesByMonth(userId, year, month);

      // Get balances for the month
      final balances =
          await supabaseService.getBalancesByMonth(userId, year, month);

      // Get transaction totals
      final transactionTotals = await supabaseService
          .getTransactionTotalsByMonth(userId, year, month);

      // Get transaction timeline for daily data
      final timeline =
          await supabaseService.getTransactionTimeline(userId, year, month);

      if (timeline.isNotEmpty) {}

      // If timeline is empty but we have expenses, create timeline entries from expenses
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> enrichedTimeline = List.from(timeline);
      if (timeline.isEmpty && expenses.isNotEmpty) {
        for (final expense in expenses) {
          enrichedTimeline.add({
            'id': 'exp_${expense.id}',
            'amount': expense.amount,
            'method': expense.method,
            'transaction_type': '-', // Expense is always outgoing
            'description': expense.description,
            'entry_date': expense.expenseDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0],
            'entry_time': expense.expenseTime,
            'expense_time': expense.expenseTime,
            'created_at': expense.expenseDate.toIso8601String(),
            'expense_id': expense.id,
            'total_balance':
                0.0, // We don't have balance info for expenses alone
          });
        }
        Logger.info(
            '📊 Created ${enrichedTimeline.length} timeline entries from expenses');
      }

      // Process daily data
      final Map<String, double> dailyExpenses = {};
      final Map<String, double> dailyBalances = {};

      // Get days in month
      final daysInMonth = DateTime(year, month + 1, 0).day;
      for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
        final dateKey =
            DateTime(year, month, day).toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
        dailyExpenses[dateKey] = 0.0;
        dailyBalances[dateKey] = 0.0;
      }

      // Fill expenses data
      for (final expense in expenses) {
        final dateKey = expense.expenseDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
        dailyExpenses[dateKey] = (dailyExpenses[dateKey] ?? 0) + expense.amount;
      }

      // Fill balance data from timeline
      double runningBalance = 0.0;
      final sortedTimeline = List.from(enrichedTimeline);
      sortedTimeline.sort((a, b) => a['entry_date'].compareTo(b['entry_date']));

      for (final transaction in sortedTimeline) {
        final dateKey = transaction['entry_date'] as String;
        final amount = transaction['amount'] as double;
        final transactionType = transaction['transaction_type'] as String;

        if (transactionType == '+') {
          runningBalance += amount;
        } else {
          runningBalance -= amount;
        }

        dailyBalances[dateKey] = runningBalance;
      }

      // Fill empty days with previous balance
      double lastBalance = 0.0;
      for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
        final dateKey =
            DateTime(year, month, day).toIso8601String().split('T')[0];
        if (dailyBalances[dateKey] == 0.0 && lastBalance > 0) {
          dailyBalances[dateKey] = lastBalance;
        } else if (dailyBalances[dateKey]! > 0) {
          lastBalance = dailyBalances[dateKey]!;
        }
      }

      final monthYear = '$year-${month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

      // Store in cache
      await db.insert(
        _analyticsTable,
        {
          'user_id': userId,
          'month_year': monthYear,
          'daily_expenses': _mapToJson(dailyExpenses),
          'daily_balances': _mapToJson(dailyBalances),
          'total_expense': expenses.fold<double>(
              0.0, (sum, expense) => sum + expense.amount),
          'total_income': transactionTotals['incremental'] ?? 0.0,
          'cash_balance': balances['cash'] ?? 0.0,
          'online_balance': balances['online'] ?? 0.0,
          'timeline_data': _timelineToJson(enrichedTimeline),
          'cached_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  // Get cached analytics data
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> getCachedAnalyticsData(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    final db = await database;
    final monthYear = '$year-${month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    final result = await db.query(
      _analyticsTable,
      where: 'user_id = ? AND month_year = ?',
      whereArgs: [userId, monthYear],
    );

    if (result.isEmpty) return null;

    final data = result.first;
    return {
      'daily_expenses': _jsonToMap(data['daily_expenses'] as String),
      'daily_balances': _jsonToMap(data['daily_balances'] as String),
      'total_expense': data['total_expense'] as double,
      'total_income': data['total_income'] as double,
      'cash_balance': data['cash_balance'] as double,
      'online_balance': data['online_balance'] as double,
      'timeline_data':
          _jsonToTimeline(data['timeline_data'] as String? ?? '[]'),
      'cached_at': data['cached_at'] as String,
    };
  }

  // Check if cache is fresh (less than 30 minutes old)
  static Future<bool> isCacheFresh(String userId, int year, int month) async {
    final data = await getCachedAnalyticsData(userId, year, month);
    if (data == null) return false;

    final cachedAt = DateTime.parse(data['cached_at'] as String);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final difference = now.difference(cachedAt).inMinutes;

    return difference <
        5; // Cache is fresh if less than 5 minutes old (reduced for testing)
  }

  // Get analytics data (cached or fresh)
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getAnalyticsData(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    // Try to get cached data first
    if (await isCacheFresh(userId, year, month)) {
      final cachedData = await getCachedAnalyticsData(userId, year, month);
      if (cachedData != null) {
        return cachedData;
      }
    }

    // If no fresh cache, fetch and cache new data

    await cacheAnalyticsData(userId, year, month);
    final freshData = await getCachedAnalyticsData(userId, year, month);
    return freshData ?? {};
  }

  // Force refresh analytics data (clears cache first)
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> forceRefreshAnalyticsData(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    // Clear existing cache for this month
    final db = await database;
    final monthYear = '$year-${month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    await db.delete(
      _analyticsTable,
      where: 'user_id = ? AND month_year = ?',
      whereArgs: [userId, monthYear],
    );

    // Fetch and cache new data
    await cacheAnalyticsData(userId, year, month);
    final freshData = await getCachedAnalyticsData(userId, year, month);
    return freshData ?? {};
  }

  // Clear old cache (keep only last 3 months)
  static Future<void> clearOldCache(String userId) async {
    final db = await database;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final threeMonthsAgo = DateTime(now.year, now.month - 3, 1);
    final cutoffMonthYear =
        '${threeMonthsAgo.year}-${threeMonthsAgo.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    await db.delete(
      _analyticsTable,
      where: 'user_id = ? AND month_year < ?',
      whereArgs: [userId, cutoffMonthYear],
    );
  }

  // Helper methods for JSON conversion
  static String _mapToJson(Map<String, double> map) {
    return map.entries.map((e) => '${e.key}:${e.value}').join(',');
  }

  static Map<String, double> _jsonToMap(String json) {
    if (json.isEmpty) return {};
    final Map<String, double> result = {};
    for (final pair in json.split(',')) {
      final parts = pair.split(':');
      if (parts.length == 2) {
        result[parts[0]] = double.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? 0.0;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  static String _timelineToJson(List<Map<String, dynamic>> timeline) {
    return json.encode(timeline);
  }

  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> _jsonToTimeline(String jsonStr) {
    if (jsonStr.isEmpty) return [];
    try {
      final List<dynamic> parsed = json.decode(jsonStr);
      return parsed.map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)).toList();
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // Clear all analytics cache
  static Future<void> clearAllCache() async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.delete(_analyticsTable);
  }
}

class LocalStorageService {
  static final LocalStorageService _instance = LocalStorageService._internal();
  factory LocalStorageService() => _instance;

  static Database? _database;

  static const String _databaseName = 'my_database.db';
  static const int _databaseVersion = 1;

  LocalStorageService._internal();

  Future<Database> get database async {
    _database ??= await _initDatabase();
    return _database!;
  }

  // Initialize the database
  static Future<Database> _initDatabase() async {
    final dbPath = await getDatabasesPath();
    final path = join(dbPath, _databaseName);

    return await openDatabase(
      path,
      version: _databaseVersion,
      onCreate: (db, version) async {
        // Create tables
        await db.execute('''
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            password TEXT NOT NULL
          )
        ''');

        await db.execute('''
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expenses (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            amount REAL NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            date TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
          )
        ''');

        await db.execute('''
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incomes (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            amount REAL NOT NULL,
            source TEXT,
            date TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
          )
        ''');
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class SessionService {
  static final SessionService _instance = SessionService._internal();
  factory SessionService() => _instance;
  SessionService._internal();

  static const String _lastActivityKey = 'last_activity';
  Timer? _backgroundTimer;

  /// Initialize session monitoring
  void initialize() {
    _updateLastActivity();
  }

  /// Update last activity timestamp
  Future<void> _updateLastActivity() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setInt(_lastActivityKey, DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch);
  }

  /// Check if the session should be refreshed based on activity
  Future<bool> shouldRefreshSession() async {
    try {
      final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
      if (session == null) return false;

      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final lastActivity = prefs.getInt(_lastActivityKey) ?? 0;
      final lastActivityTime =
          DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(lastActivity);
      final timeSinceActivity = DateTime.now().difference(lastActivityTime);

      // Check if session expires soon or if user has been inactive
      final expiryTime =
          DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(session.expiresAt! * 1000);
      final timeUntilExpiry = expiryTime.difference(DateTime.now());

      // Refresh if expires within 10 minutes or if inactive for more than 30 minutes
      return timeUntilExpiry.inMinutes <= 10 ||
          timeSinceActivity.inMinutes > 30;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Refresh session if needed
  Future<bool> refreshSessionIfNeeded() async {
    try {
      if (await shouldRefreshSession()) {
        await Supabase.instance.client.auth.refreshSession();
        await _updateLastActivity();

        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Call this when user interacts with the app
  Future<void> recordUserActivity() async {
    await _updateLastActivity();
  }

  /// Start monitoring for background state
  void startBackgroundMonitoring() {
    _backgroundTimer?.cancel();
    _backgroundTimer =
        Timer.periodic(const Duration(minutes: 15), (timer) async {
      try {
        final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
        if (session != null) {
          await refreshSessionIfNeeded();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Silently ignore errors during background session refresh
      }
    });
  }

  /// Stop background monitoring
  void stopBackgroundMonitoring() {
    _backgroundTimer?.cancel();
    _backgroundTimer = null;
  }

  /// Check if user is authenticated with valid session
  bool isAuthenticated() {
    final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
    if (session == null) return false;

    final expiryTime =
        DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(session.expiresAt! * 1000);
    final isExpired = expiryTime.isBefore(DateTime.now());

    return !isExpired;
  }

  /// Get session expiry information
  SessionInfo? getSessionInfo() {
    final session = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentSession;
    if (session == null) return null;

    final expiryTime =
        DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(session.expiresAt! * 1000);
    final timeUntilExpiry = expiryTime.difference(DateTime.now());

    return SessionInfo(
      userId: session.user.id,
      email: session.user.email ?? '',
      expiryTime: expiryTime,
      minutesUntilExpiry: timeUntilExpiry.inMinutes,
      isExpired: timeUntilExpiry.isNegative,
    );
  }

  void dispose() {
    stopBackgroundMonitoring();
  }
}

class SessionInfo {
  final String userId;
  final String email;
  final DateTime expiryTime;
  final int minutesUntilExpiry;
  final bool isExpired;

  SessionInfo({
    required this.userId,
    required this.email,
    required this.expiryTime,
    required this.minutesUntilExpiry,
    required this.isExpired,
  });

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'SessionInfo(userId: $userId, email: $email, expiryTime: $expiryTime, minutesUntilExpiry: $minutesUntilExpiry, isExpired: $isExpired)';
  }
}
