import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../models/expense.dart';

class SupabaseService {
  final SupabaseClient _client = Supabase.instance.client;

  Future<List<Expense>> getExpensesByDate(String userId, DateTime date) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('expenses')
          .select()
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .eq('expense_date', date.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

      return response.map((json) => Expense.fromJson(json)).toList();
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Expense>> getExpensesByMonth(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    try {
      final startDate = DateTime(year, month, 1);
      final endDate = DateTime(year, month + 1, 0);
      final response = await _client
          .from('expenses')
          .select()
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .gte('expense_date', startDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .lte('expense_date', endDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .order('expense_date', ascending: true);

      return response.map((json) => Expense.fromJson(json)).toList();
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> addExpense(Expense expense) async {
    try {
      // Insert the expense
      final expenseResponse = await _client
          .from('expenses')
          .insert(expense.toJson())
          .select('id')
          .single();

      // Also create a corresponding balance entry for expense tracking
      final balanceData = {
        'user_id': expense.userId,
        'entry_date': DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(expense.expenseDate),
        'entry_time': expense.expenseTime,
        'description': expense.description,
        'amount': expense.amount,
        'method': expense.method,
        'transaction_type': '-', // Expense is always a debit
        'created_at': expense.createdAt.toIso8601String(),
        'updated_at': expense.updatedAt.toIso8601String(),
        'expense_id': expenseResponse['id'],
        'total_balance': 0.0, // Will be calculated by trigger or updated later
      };

      // Insert balance entry
      await _client.from('balance').insert(balanceData);
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> updateExpense(Expense expense) async {
    try {
      // if (expense.id == null)
      //   throw Exception('Expense ID is required for update');

      await _client
          .from('expenses')
          .update(expense.toJson())
          .eq('id', expense.id!);
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteExpense(String expenseId) async {
    try {
      // final response =
      await _client.from('expenses').delete().eq('id', expenseId);
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteExpensesAndBalancesByDate(
      String userId, String date) async {
    try {
      await _client.rpc('delete_expenses_and_balances_by_date', params: {
        'p_user_id': userId,
        'p_date': date,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteExpensesAndBalancesByDateAndMethod(
      String userId, String date, String method) async {
    try {
      // print(
      //     'Deleting expenses and balances for user: $userId, date: $date, method: $method');
      await _client
          .rpc('delete_expenses_and_balances_by_date_and_method', params: {
        'p_user_id': userId,
        'p_date': date,
        'p_method': method,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getBalances(String userId) async {
    try {
      final response = await _client
          .from('balance')
          .select('amount, method, transaction_type')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

      double cashBalance = 0.0;
      double onlineBalance = 0.0;
      double totalBalance = 0.0;

      for (var record in response) {
        final amount = (record['amount'] as num).toDouble();
        final method = record['method'] as String;
        final transactionType = record['transaction_type'] as String;

        final adjustedAmount = transactionType == '+' ? amount : -amount;

        if (method == 'cash') {
          cashBalance += adjustedAmount;
        } else if (method == 'online') {
          onlineBalance += adjustedAmount;
        }
        totalBalance += adjustedAmount;
      }

      // print(
      //     'Calculated Balances - Cash: $cashBalance, Online: $onlineBalance, Total: $totalBalance');

      return {
        'cash': cashBalance,
        'online': onlineBalance,
        'total': totalBalance,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getBalancesByMonth(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    try {
      final startDate = DateTime(year, month, 1);
      final endDate = DateTime(year, month + 1, 0);
      final response = await _client
          .from('balance')
          .select('amount, method, transaction_type')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .gte('entry_date', startDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .lte('entry_date', endDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

      double cashBalance = 0.0;
      double onlineBalance = 0.0;
      double totalBalance = 0.0;

      for (var record in response) {
        final amount = (record['amount'] as num).toDouble();
        final method = record['method'] as String;
        final transactionType = record['transaction_type'] as String;

        final adjustedAmount = transactionType == '+' ? amount : -amount;

        if (method == 'cash') {
          cashBalance += adjustedAmount;
        } else if (method == 'online') {
          onlineBalance += adjustedAmount;
        }
        totalBalance += adjustedAmount;
      }

      // print(
      //     'Calculated Balances for $year-$month - Cash: $cashBalance, Online: $onlineBalance, Total: $totalBalance');

      return {
        'cash': cashBalance,
        'online': onlineBalance,
        'total': totalBalance,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'cash': 0.0,
        'online': 0.0,
        'total': 0.0,
      };
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getTransactionTotalsByMonth(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    try {
      final startDate = DateTime(year, month, 1);
      final endDate = DateTime(year, month + 1, 0);
      final response = await _client
          .from('balance')
          .select('amount, transaction_type')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .gte('entry_date', startDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .lte('entry_date', endDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .order('created_at', ascending: true);

      double incrementalTotal = 0.0;
      double decrementalTotal = 0.0;

      for (var record in response) {
        final amount = (record['amount'] as num).toDouble();
        final transactionType = record['transaction_type'] as String;

        if (transactionType == '+') {
          incrementalTotal += amount;
        } else if (transactionType == '-') {
          decrementalTotal += amount;
        }
      }

      // print(
      //     'Transaction Totals for $year-$month - Incremental: $incrementalTotal, Decremental: $decrementalTotal');

      return {
        'incremental': incrementalTotal,
        'decremental': decrementalTotal,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'incremental': 0.0,
        'decremental': 0.0,
      };
    }
  }

  Future<void> addBalance(Map<String, dynamic> balanceData) async {
    try {
      if (balanceData['transaction_type'] == '-') {
        // For decrements, insert into expenses and let the trigger handle balance
        final expenseData = {
          'user_id': balanceData['user_id'],
          'expense_date': balanceData['entry_date'],
          'expense_time': balanceData['entry_time'],
          'description': balanceData['description'],
          'amount': balanceData['amount'],
          'method': balanceData['method'],
          'created_at': balanceData['created_at'],
          'updated_at': balanceData['updated_at'],
        };
        final expenseResponse = await _client
            .from('expenses')
            .insert(expenseData)
            .select('id')
            .single();
        // Do not insert into balance table here; let the trigger do it
        balanceData['expense_id'] = expenseResponse['id'];
        // print(
        //     'Expense inserted for decrement: ${expenseData['description']}, Expense ID: ${balanceData['expense_id']}');
      } else {
        // For increments, insert directly into balance
        balanceData['expense_id'] = null;
        await _client.from('balance').insert(balanceData);
        // print(
        //     'Balance inserted: ${balanceData['description']}, Response: $response');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> updateBalance(Map<String, dynamic> updatedBalance) async {
    try {
      if (updatedBalance['id'] == null) {
        throw Exception('Balance ID is required for update');
      }
      final balanceId = updatedBalance['id'];
      // print(
      //     'Updating balance: ${updatedBalance['description']}, ID: $balanceId');

      // Fetch the current balance row
      final currentBalanceResponse = await _client
          .from('balance')
          .select('transaction_type, expense_id, total_balance')
          .eq('id', balanceId)
          .maybeSingle(); // Use maybeSingle to handle no rows gracefully

      if (currentBalanceResponse == null) {
        throw Exception('No balance row found for ID: $balanceId');
      }

      final currentBalance = currentBalanceResponse;
      final originalTransactionType = currentBalance['transaction_type'];
      final newTransactionType = updatedBalance['transaction_type'];

      if (originalTransactionType == newTransactionType) {
        // No change in transaction type, update existing row
        if (newTransactionType == '-') {
          if (currentBalance['expense_id'] != null) {
            final expenseData = {
              'user_id': updatedBalance['user_id'],
              'expense_date': updatedBalance['entry_date'],
              'expense_time': updatedBalance['entry_time'],
              'description': updatedBalance['description'],
              'amount': updatedBalance['amount'],
              'method': updatedBalance['method'],
              'updated_at': updatedBalance['updated_at'],
            };
            await _client
                .from('expenses')
                .update(expenseData)
                .eq('id', currentBalance['expense_id']);
          }
        }
        // Update balance row with recalculated total_balance if amount changed
        final updateData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(updatedBalance);
        updateData.remove('id');
        if (newTransactionType == '+' && updatedBalance['amount'] != null) {
          final currentTotal = currentBalance['total_balance'] ?? 0.0;
          final oldAmount = (await _client
                  .from('balance')
                  .select('amount')
                  .eq('id', balanceId)
                  .single())['amount'] ??
              0.0;
          final newAmount = updatedBalance['amount'];
          updateData['total_balance'] =
              currentTotal - oldAmount + newAmount; // Adjust total_balance
        }
        await _client.from('balance').update(updateData).eq('id', balanceId);
      } else {
        // Transaction type is changing
        if (newTransactionType == '-') {
          // Changing from '+' to '-', insert new expense
          final expenseData = {
            'user_id': updatedBalance['user_id'],
            'expense_date': updatedBalance['entry_date'],
            'expense_time': updatedBalance['entry_time'],
            'description': updatedBalance['description'],
            'amount': updatedBalance['amount'],
            'method': updatedBalance['method'],
            'created_at': updatedBalance['created_at'],
            'updated_at': updatedBalance['updated_at'],
          };
          await _client.from('expenses').insert(expenseData);
          await _client.from('balance').delete().eq('id', balanceId);
        } else {
          // Changing from '-' to '+', delete expense and insert new balance
          if (currentBalance['expense_id'] != null) {
            await _client
                .from('expenses')
                .delete()
                .eq('id', currentBalance['expense_id']);
          }
          await _client.from('balance').delete().eq('id', balanceId);

          final newBalanceData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(updatedBalance);
          newBalanceData.remove('id');
          newBalanceData['expense_id'] = null;

          // Calculate total_balance
          final currentBalances = await getBalances(updatedBalance['user_id']);
          final previousTotal = currentBalances['total'] ?? 0.0;
          newBalanceData['total_balance'] =
              previousTotal + updatedBalance['amount'];

          await _client.from('balance').insert(newBalanceData);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteBalance(String balanceId) async {
    try {
      if (balanceId.isEmpty) {
        throw Exception('Balance ID is required for deletion');
      }

      final balance = await _client
          .from('balance')
          .select('expense_id, transaction_type')
          .eq('id', balanceId)
          .single();
      if (balance['transaction_type'] == '-' &&
          balance['expense_id'] != null &&
          balance['expense_id'].isNotEmpty) {
        await _client.from('expenses').delete().eq('id', balance['expense_id']);
      }
      // final response =
      await _client.from('balance').delete().eq('id', balanceId);
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteExpenseAndBalance(String expenseId) async {
    try {
      // print(
      //     'Starting deletion of expense ID: $expenseId and associated balance');
      await _client.rpc('delete_expense_and_balance', params: {
        'p_expense_id': expenseId,
      });
      // print(
      //     'Successfully deleted expense ID: $expenseId and associated balance');
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getTransactionTimeline(
      String userId, int year, int month) async {
    try {
      final startDate = DateTime(year, month, 1);
      final endDate = DateTime(year, month + 1, 0);

      // print(
      //     '   Date range: ${startDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0]} to ${endDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0]}');

      final response = await _client
          .from('balance')
          .select('''
            id, 
            amount, 
            method, 
            transaction_type, 
            description, 
            entry_date, 
            entry_time, 
            created_at, 
            expense_id, 
            total_balance,
            expenses!balance_expense_id_fkey!left(expense_time)
          ''')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .gte('entry_date', startDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .lte('entry_date', endDate.toIso8601String().split('T')[0])
          .order('entry_date', ascending: false)
          .order('created_at', ascending: false);

      if (response.isNotEmpty) {}

      return response
          .map((record) => {
                'id': record['id'] as String,
                'amount': (record['amount'] as num).toDouble(),
                'method': record['method'] as String,
                'transaction_type': record['transaction_type'] as String,
                'description': record['description'] as String?,
                'entry_date': record['entry_date'] as String,
                'entry_time': record['entry_time'] as String?,
                'expense_time': record['expenses'] != null
                    ? record['expenses']['expense_time'] as String?
                    : null,
                'created_at': record['created_at'] as String,
                'expense_id': record['expense_id'] as String?,
                'total_balance':
                    (record['total_balance'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
              })
          .toList();
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }
}

215. lib\utils\logger.dart ::
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

class Logger {
  static void debug(String message) {
    if (kDebugMode) {
      print('[DEBUG] $message');
    }
  }

  static void info(String message) {
    if (kDebugMode) {
      print('[INFO] $message');
    }
  }

  static void warning(String message) {
    if (kDebugMode) {
      print('[WARNING] $message');
    }
  }

  static void error(String message, [Object? error, StackTrace? stackTrace]) {
    if (kDebugMode) {
      print('[ERROR] $message');
      if (error != null) print('Error: $error');
      if (stackTrace != null) print('StackTrace: $stackTrace');
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'top_message.dart';

class AddExpenseForm extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onExpenseAdded;

  const AddExpenseForm({
    super.key,
    this.onExpenseAdded,
  });

  @override
  AddExpenseFormState createState() => AddExpenseFormState();
}

class AddExpenseFormState extends State<AddExpenseForm> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _descriptionController = TextEditingController();
  final _amountController = TextEditingController();
  String _method = 'cash';
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  bool _isLoading = false;

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = true;
      });
      try {
        final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;

        if (currentUser == null) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Error: User not authenticated')),
          );
          Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
            context,
            MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
            (route) => false,
          );
          return;
        }
        final now = DateTime.now();
        // final dateFormat = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd');
        final timeFormat = DateFormat('HH:mm:ss');
        final expense = Expense(
          id: null, // Omit id to let Supabase generate UUID
          userId: currentUser.id,
          expenseDate: now, // Will be formatted to string in toJson
          expenseTime: timeFormat.format(now), // Store time as HH:mm:ss
          description: _descriptionController.text.trim(),
          amount: double.parse(_amountController.text),
          method: _method,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        );

        await _supabaseService.addExpense(expense);
        if (mounted) {
          // Show success message
          TopMessage.show(
            context,
            message: 'Expense added successfully!',
            type: MessageType.success,
          );

          Navigator.pop(context);
          widget.onExpenseAdded?.call();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          String errorMessage = 'Error adding expense';
          if (e.toString().contains('PostgrestException')) {
            errorMessage = 'Failed to save expense. Please try again.';
          } else if (e.toString().contains('network') ||
              e.toString().contains('connection')) {
            errorMessage = 'Network error. Please check your connection.';
          }

          TopMessage.show(
            context,
            message: errorMessage,
            type: MessageType.error,
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isLoading = false;
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _descriptionController.dispose();
    _amountController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        if (_isLoading)
          TopProgressBar(
            isVisible: _isLoading,
            message: 'Adding expense...',
          ),
        AlertDialog(
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
          backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
          elevation: 8,
          title: Text(
            'Add Expense',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                ),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          content: Form(
            key: _formKey,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _descriptionController,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Description',
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.description),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor:
                          Theme.of(context).cardColor.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                    ),
                    validator: (value) =>
                        value!.isEmpty ? 'Enter a description' : null,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _amountController,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Amount (₹)',
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.currency_rupee),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor:
                          Theme.of(context).cardColor.withValues(alpha: .9),
                    ),
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    validator: (value) {
                      if (value!.isEmpty) return 'Enter an amount';
                      final amount = double.tryParse(value);
                      if (amount == null) return 'Enter a valid number';
                      if (amount <= 0) return 'Amount must be positive';
                      return null;
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(
                    'Payment Method',
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                        ),
                  ),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Radio<String>(
                        value: 'cash',
                        groupValue: _method,
                        onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _method = value!),
                        activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                      ),
                      const Text('Cash'),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Radio<String>(
                        value: 'online',
                        groupValue: _method,
                        onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _method = value!),
                        activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                      ),
                      const Text('Online'),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              child: Text(
                'Cancel',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    ),
              ),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _submit,
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,

                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16, horizontal: 24),

class DeleteExpenseFormState extends State<DeleteExpenseForm> {
  String _selectedMethod = 'both';
  bool _isLoading = false;
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();

  Future<void> _deleteExpenses() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
      if (currentUser == null) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Error: User not authenticated')),
        );
        Navigator.pop(context);
        return;

      final dateStr = widget.date.toIso8601String().split('T')[0];

      if (_selectedMethod == 'both') {
        await _supabaseService.deleteExpensesAndBalancesByDate(userId, dateStr);
      } else {
        await _supabaseService.deleteExpensesAndBalancesByDateAndMethod(
            userId, dateStr, _selectedMethod);

        Navigator.pop(context);

        );

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;

  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import '../main.dart';
import '../services/supabase_service.dart';
import 'top_message.dart';

class EditBalanceForm extends StatefulWidget {
  final Map<String, dynamic> transaction;
  final VoidCallback? onBalanceUpdated;

  const EditBalanceForm({
    super.key,
    required this.transaction,
    this.onBalanceUpdated,
  });

  @override
  EditBalanceFormState createState() => EditBalanceFormState();
}

class EditBalanceFormState extends State<EditBalanceForm> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _descriptionController = TextEditingController();
  final _amountController = TextEditingController();
  String _method = 'cash';
  String _transactionType = '+';
  DateTime _selectedDate = DateTime.now();
  TimeOfDay _selectedTime = TimeOfDay.now();
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _descriptionController.text = widget.transaction['description'] ?? '';
    _amountController.text = widget.transaction['amount'].toStringAsFixed(1);
    _method = widget.transaction['method'] ?? 'cash';
    _transactionType = widget.transaction['transaction_type'] ?? '+';
    _selectedDate = DateTime.parse(widget.transaction['entry_date']);
    final timeString = _transactionType == '+'
        ? (widget.transaction['entry_time'] ?? '00:00:00')
        : (widget.transaction['expense_time'] ??
            widget.transaction['entry_time'] ??
            '00:00:00');
    final timeParts = timeString.split(':');
    _selectedTime = TimeOfDay(
      hour: int.parse(timeParts[0]),
      minute: int.parse(timeParts[1]),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _descriptionController.dispose();
    _amountController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context) async {
    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: _selectedDate,
      firstDate: DateTime(2000),
      lastDate: DateTime(2101),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked != _selectedDate) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedDate = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectTime(BuildContext context) async {
    final TimeOfDay? picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: _selectedTime,
    );
    if (picked != null && picked != _selectedTime) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedTime = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _updateBalance() async {
    if (_isLoading) return; // Prevent multiple submissions
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
      if (currentUser == null) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error: User not authenticated',
          type: MessageType.error,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
        Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
          (route) => false,
        );
        return;
      }

      if (widget.transaction['id'] == null) {
        throw Exception('Transaction ID is missing');
      }

      final updatedBalance = {
        'id': widget.transaction['id'],
        'user_id': currentUser.id,
        'entry_date': DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_selectedDate),
        'entry_time': _selectedTime.format24Hour(),
        'description': _descriptionController.text.trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : _descriptionController.text.trim(),
        'amount': double.parse(_amountController.text),
        'method': _method,
        'transaction_type': _transactionType,
        'created_at': widget.transaction['created_at'],
        'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        'expense_id': widget.transaction['expense_id'],
      };

      await _supabaseService.updateBalance(updatedBalance);
      if (mounted) {
        // Show success message
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Balance updated successfully',
          type: MessageType.success,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        );
        // Call callback to refresh parent data
        widget.onBalanceUpdated?.call();
        // Close the dialog
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error updating balance: $e',
          type: MessageType.error,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteBalance() async {
    if (_isLoading) return; // Prevent multiple submissions
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
      if (currentUser == null) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error: User not authenticated',
          type: MessageType.error,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
        Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
          (route) => false,
        );
        return;
      }

      if (widget.transaction['id'] == null) {
        throw Exception('Transaction ID is missing');
      }

      await _supabaseService.deleteBalance(widget.transaction['id']);
      if (mounted) {
        // Show success message
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Balance deleted successfully',
          type: MessageType.success,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        );
        // Call callback to refresh parent data
        widget.onBalanceUpdated?.call();
        // Close the dialog
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error deleting balance: $e',
          type: MessageType.error,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

extension TimeOfDayExtension on TimeOfDay {
  String format24Hour() {
    final hour = this.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final minute = this.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$hour:$minute:00';
  }
}

class EditExpenseFormState extends State<EditExpenseForm> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _descriptionController = TextEditingController();
  final _amountController = TextEditingController();
  String _method = 'cash';
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Pre-fill form with expense data
    _descriptionController.text = widget.expense.description;
    _amountController.text = widget.expense.amount.toStringAsFixed(1);
    _method = widget.expense.method;
  }

  Future<void> _updateExpense() async {
    if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = true;
      });
      try {
        final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
        if (currentUser == null) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Error: User not authenticated')),
          );
          Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
            context,
            MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AuthScreen()),
            (route) => false,
          );
          return;
        }
        final updatedExpense = Expense(
          id: widget.expense.id,
          userId: currentUser.id,
          expenseDate: widget.expense.expenseDate,
          expenseTime: widget.expense.expenseTime,
          description: _descriptionController.text.trim(),
          amount: double.parse(_amountController.text),
          method: _method,
          createdAt: widget.expense.createdAt,
          updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
        );
        await _supabaseService.updateExpense(updatedExpense);
        if (mounted) {
          TopMessage.show(
            context,
            message: 'Expense updated successfully!',
            type: MessageType.success,
          );
          Navigator.pop(context);
          widget.onExpenseUpdated?.call();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          String errorMessage = 'Error updating expense';
          if (e.toString().contains('network') ||
              e.toString().contains('connection')) {
            errorMessage = 'Network error. Please check your connection.';
          }
          TopMessage.show(
            context,
            message: errorMessage,
            type: MessageType.error,
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isLoading = false;
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteExpense() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });
    try {
      await _supabaseService.deleteExpenseAndBalance(widget.expense.id!);
      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ExpenseCard extends StatefulWidget {
  final String title;
  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const ExpenseCard({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.icon,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  ExpenseCardState createState() => ExpenseCardState();
}

class ExpenseCardState extends State<ExpenseCard>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  AnimationController? _controller;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _bounceAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeController();
  }

  void _initializeController() {
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300), // Match BalanceScreen
      vsync: this,
    );
    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 1.0, end: 1.07).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller!, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );
    _bounceAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: -2.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller!, curve: Curves.bounceOut),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onTapDown(TapDownDetails details) {
    if (mounted && _controller != null && !_controller!.isAnimating) {
      _controller!.forward();
    }
  }

  void _onTapUp(TapUpDetails details) {
    if (mounted && _controller != null) {
      _controller!.reverse().then((_) => widget.onTap());
    }
  }

  void _onTapCancel() {
    if (mounted && _controller != null) {
      _controller!.reverse();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_controller == null) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink(); // Fallback if controller is null
    }
    return GestureDetector(
      onTapDown: _onTapDown,
      onTapUp: _onTapUp,
      onTapCancel: _onTapCancel,
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _controller!,
        builder: (context, child) {
          return Transform.scale(
            scale: _scaleAnimation.value,
            child: Transform.translate(
              offset: Offset(0, _bounceAnimation.value),
              child: Card(
                elevation: 8.0, // Fixed elevation, consistent with HomeScreen
                shadowColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                        blurRadius: 8,
                        offset: const Offset(2, 2),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: Theme.of(context)
                              .cardColor, // Use card color for background
                          boxShadow: [
                            BoxShadow(
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .shadowColor
                                  .withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                              blurRadius: 6,
                              offset: const Offset(2, 2),
                            ),
                            BoxShadow(
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .shadowColor
                                  .withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                              blurRadius: 4,
                              offset: const Offset(-2, -2),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        child: Transform.scale(
                          scale: 1.1,
                          child: Icon(
                            widget.icon,
                            size: 48,
                            color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        widget.title,
                        style:
                            Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

class ExpenseTable extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<Expense> expenses;
  final int selectedMonth;
  final int selectedYear;

  const ExpenseTable({
    super.key,
    required this.expenses,
    required this.selectedMonth,
    required this.selectedYear,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      scrollDirection: Axis.vertical,
      child: DataTable(
        columns: const [
          DataColumn(label: Text('Date')),
          DataColumn(label: Text('Description')),
          DataColumn(label: Text('Amount')),
          DataColumn(label: Text('Method')),
        ],
        rows: expenses.map((expense) {
          return DataRow(cells: [
            DataCell(Text(DateFormat.yMd().format(expense.expenseDate))),
            DataCell(Text(expense.description)),
            DataCell(Text('\$${expense.amount.toStringAsFixed(2)}')),
            DataCell(Text(expense.method == 'cash' ? 'Cash' : 'Online')),
          ]);
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  final _amountController = TextEditingController();
  String _method = 'cash';
  String _transactionType = '+';
  DateTime _selectedDate = DateTime.now();
  TimeOfDay _selectedTime = TimeOfDay.now();
  final _supabaseService = SupabaseService();
  bool _isSubmitting = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedDate = DateTime.now();
    _selectedTime = TimeOfDay.now();
  }

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context) async {
    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: _selectedDate,
      firstDate: DateTime(2000),
      lastDate: DateTime(2101),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked != _selectedDate) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedDate = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectTime(BuildContext context) async {
    final TimeOfDay? picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: _selectedTime,
    );
    if (picked != null && picked != _selectedTime) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedTime = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_isSubmitting) return; // Prevent multiple submissions
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    setState(() {
      _isSubmitting = true;
    });

    try {
      final currentUser = Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser;
      if (currentUser == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          TopMessage.show(
            context,
            message: 'Error: User not authenticated',
            type: MessageType.error,
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
          );
          Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, '/auth');
        }
        return;
      }

      final amount = double.tryParse(_amountController.text);
      if (amount == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          TopMessage.show(
            context,
            message: 'Error: Invalid amount format',
            type: MessageType.error,
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      final currentBalances =
          await _supabaseService.getBalances(currentUser.id);
      double currentTotalBalance = currentBalances['total'] ?? 0.0;
      final newTotalBalance = _transactionType == '+'
          ? currentTotalBalance + amount
          : currentTotalBalance - amount;

      final balanceData = {
        'user_id': currentUser.id,
        'entry_date': DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_selectedDate),
        'entry_time': _selectedTime.format24Hour(),
        'description': _descriptionController.text.trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : _descriptionController.text.trim(),
        'amount': amount,
        'method': _method,
        'transaction_type': _transactionType,
        'total_balance': newTotalBalance,
        'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        'expense_id': _transactionType == '-' ? '' : null,
      };

      await _supabaseService.addBalance(balanceData);

      if (mounted) {
        // Show success message
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Balance added successfully!',
          type: MessageType.success,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        );

        // Clear form fields to prevent re-submission
        _descriptionController.clear();
        _amountController.clear();
        setState(() {
          _method = 'cash';
          _transactionType = '+';
          _selectedDate = DateTime.now();
          _selectedTime = TimeOfDay.now();
        });

        // Call callback to refresh parent data
        widget.onBalanceAdded?.call();

        // Delay closing the dialog to ensure TopMessage is visible
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2));
        if (mounted) {
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        TopMessage.show(
          context,
          message: 'Error adding balance: ${e.toString()}',
          type: MessageType.error,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isSubmitting = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _descriptionController.dispose();
    _amountController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
      elevation: 8,
      title: Text(
        'Add Balance',
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
            ),
        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
      ),
      content: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              TextFormField(
                controller: _descriptionController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Description',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.description),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  filled: true,
                  fillColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                ),
                enabled: !_isSubmitting,
                validator: (value) =>
                    value!.isEmpty ? 'Enter a description' : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                controller: _amountController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Amount',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.currency_rupee),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  filled: true,
                  fillColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                ),
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                enabled: !_isSubmitting,
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value!.isEmpty) return 'Enter an amount';
                  final amount = double.tryParse(value);
                  if (amount == null) return 'Enter a valid number';
                  if (amount <= 0) return 'Amount must be positive';
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                readOnly: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Date',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  filled: true,
                  fillColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                ),
                controller: TextEditingController(
                  text: DateFormat.yMd().format(_selectedDate),
                ),
                onTap: _isSubmitting ? null : () => _selectDate(context),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextFormField(
                readOnly: true,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Time',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  filled: true,
                  fillColor: Theme.of(context).cardColor.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                ),
                controller: TextEditingController(
                  text: _selectedTime.format(context),
                ),
                onTap: _isSubmitting ? null : () => _selectTime(context),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'Payment Method',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.left,
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  RadioListTile<String>(
                    title: const Text('Cash', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
                    value: 'cash',
                    groupValue: _method,
                    onChanged: _isSubmitting
                        ? null
                        : (value) => setState(() => _method = value!),
                    activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    dense: true,
                  ),
                  RadioListTile<String>(
                    title: const Text('Online', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
                    value: 'online',
                    groupValue: _method,
                    onChanged: _isSubmitting
                        ? null
                        : (value) => setState(() => _method = value!),
                    activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    dense: true,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'Transaction Type',

                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,

                textAlign: TextAlign.left,

                  RadioListTile<String>(

                    value: '+',
                    groupValue: _transactionType,
                    onChanged: _isSubmitting
                        ? null
                        : (value) => setState(() => _transactionType = value!),
                    activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    dense: true,
                  ),
                  RadioListTile<String>(
                    title: const Text('Debit', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
                    value: '-',
                    groupValue: _transactionType,
                    onChanged: _isSubmitting
                        ? null
                        : (value) => setState(() => _transactionType = value!),
                    activeColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    dense: true,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: _isSubmitting ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context),
          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
            foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 16),
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),

                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
          ),
          child: const Text('Add', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

extension TimeOfDayExtension on TimeOfDay {
  String format24Hour() {
    final hour = this.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final minute = this.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$hour:$minute:00';
  }
}


224. lib\widgets\top_message.dart ::
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum MessageType { success, error, info }

class TopMessage {
  static void show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String message,
    required MessageType type,
    Duration duration =
        const Duration(seconds: 2), // Changed from 3 to 2 seconds minimum
  }) {
    final overlay = Overlay.of(context);
    late OverlayEntry overlayEntry;

    overlayEntry = OverlayEntry(
      builder: (context) => TopMessageWidget(
        message: message,
        type: type,
        onDismiss: () => overlayEntry.remove(),
      ),
    );

    overlay.insert(overlayEntry);
    Future.delayed(duration, () {
      if (overlayEntry.mounted) {
        overlayEntry.remove();
      }
    });
  }
}

class TopMessageWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final String message;
  final MessageType type;
  final VoidCallback onDismiss;

  const TopMessageWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.message,
    required this.type,
    required this.onDismiss,
  });

  @override
  State<TopMessageWidget> createState() => _TopMessageWidgetState();
}

class _TopMessageWidgetState extends State<TopMessageWidget>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<Offset> _slideAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _slideAnimation = Tween<Offset>(
      begin: const Offset(0.0, -1.0),
      end: Offset.zero,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    ));

    _fadeAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0.0,
      end: 1.0,
    ).animate(_controller);

    _controller.forward();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Color _getBackgroundColor() {
    // Use theme colors for professional look
    return Theme.of(context).cardColor;
  }

  Color _getBorderColor() {
    // Use theme accent color for all message types
    return Theme.of(context).primaryColor;
  }

  Color _getTextColor() {
    return Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.color ??
        Theme.of(context).primaryColor;
  }

  String _getIcon() {
    switch (widget.type) {
      case MessageType.success:
        return '✅';
      case MessageType.error:
        return '❌';
      case MessageType.info:
        return 'ℹ️';
    }
  }

  void _dismiss() async {
    await _controller.reverse();
    widget.onDismiss();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Positioned(
      top: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + 10,
      left: 16,
      right: 16,
      child: SlideTransition(
        position: _slideAnimation,
        child: FadeTransition(
          opacity: _fadeAnimation,
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.transparent,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _getBackgroundColor(),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                border: Border.all(color: _getBorderColor(), width: 1),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                    blurRadius: 4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    _getIcon(),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      widget.message,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: _getTextColor(),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        fontSize: 14,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: _dismiss,
                    child: Icon(
                      Icons.close,
                      size: 18,
                      color: _getTextColor(),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}


225. lib\widgets\top_progress_bar.dart ::
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class TopProgressBar extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isVisible;
  final String? message;

  const TopProgressBar({
    super.key,
    required this.isVisible,
    this.message,
  });

  @override
  State<TopProgressBar> createState() => _TopProgressBarState();
}

class _TopProgressBarState extends State<TopProgressBar>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  late Animation<Offset> _slideAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _fadeAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0.0,
      end: 1.0,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.easeIn,
    ));

    _slideAnimation = Tween<Offset>(
      begin: const Offset(0, -1),
      end: Offset.zero,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    ));
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(TopProgressBar oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.isVisible != oldWidget.isVisible) {
      if (widget.isVisible) {
        _controller.forward();
      } else {
        _controller.reverse();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!widget.isVisible && _controller.isDismissed) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return SlideTransition(
      position: _slideAnimation,
      child: FadeTransition(
        opacity: _fadeAnimation,
        child: Container(
          width: double.infinity,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: Theme.of(context).shadowColor.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                blurRadius: 4,
                offset: const Offset(0, 2),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              LinearProgressIndicator(
                backgroundColor:
                    Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                  Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                ),
              ),
              if (widget.message != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Text(
                  widget.message!,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// This is a basic Flutter widget test.
//
// To perform an interaction with a widget in your test, use the WidgetTester
// utility in the flutter_test package. For example, you can send tap and scroll
// gestures. You can also use WidgetTester to find child widgets in the widget
// tree, read text, and verify that the values of widget properties are correct.

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'package:exptrack/main.dart';

void main() {
  testWidgets('Counter increments smoke test', (WidgetTester tester) async {
    // Build our app and trigger a frame.
    await tester.pumpWidget(const MyApp());

    // Verify that our counter starts at 0.
    expect(find.text('0'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('1'), findsNothing);

    // Tap the '+' icon and trigger a frame.
    await tester.tap(find.byIcon(Icons.add));
    await tester.pump();

    // Verify that our counter has incremented.
    expect(find.text('0'), findsNothing);
    expect(find.text('1'), findsOneWidget);
  });
}
